    updateEmergencyKeyLabel();
    document.getElementById('emergencyKeyStatus').textContent = 'Emergency key reset to `.';
  }

  function emergencyIconLink() {
    let link = document.querySelector("link[rel~='icon']");
    if (!link) { link = document.createElement('link'); link.rel = 'icon'; document.head.appendChild(link); }
    return link;
  }

  function setEmergencyPreset(value) {
    const preset = EMERGENCY_PRESETS[value];
    if (preset) {
      document.getElementById('emergencyTitle').value = preset.title;
      document.getElementById('emergencyIcon').value = preset.icon;
    } else if (value === 'custom') {
      document.getElementById('emergencyTitle').value = _settings.emergencyTitle || '';
      document.getElementById('emergencyIcon').value = _settings.emergencyIcon || '';
    }
    saveEmergencySettings();
  }

  function saveEmergencySettings() {
    _settings.emergencyPreset = document.getElementById('emergencyPreset').value;
    _settings.emergencyTitle = document.getElementById('emergencyTitle').value.trim();
    _settings.emergencyIcon = document.getElementById('emergencyIcon').value.trim();
    _settings.emergencyAuto = document.getElementById('emergencyAuto').checked;
    _settings.emergencyStay = document.getElementById('emergencyStay').checked;
    try { saveSettings(); }
    catch (err) { alert('Could not save emergency settings. Your browser storage may be full.'); }
  }

  function uploadEmergencyImage(input) {
    const file = input.files && input.files[0];
    input.value = '';
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) { alert('Choose an image file.'); return; }
    const image = new Image();
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => { image.src = reader.result; };
    image.onload = () => {
      const scale = Math.min(1, 1600 / image.width, 1000 / image.height);
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(image.width * scale));
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(image.height * scale));
      canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(image, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const previous = _settings.emergencyImage;
      _settings.emergencyImage = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.78);
      try {
        saveSettings();
        document.getElementById('emergencyPreset').value = 'custom';
        setEmergencyPreset('custom');
        document.getElementById('emergencyUploadStatus').textContent = 'Screenshot saved on this device.';
      } catch (err) {
        _settings.emergencyImage = previous;
        document.getElementById('emergencyUploadStatus').textContent = 'Screenshot is too large to save. Try a smaller image.';
      }
    };
    image.onerror = () => { alert('Could not read that image.'); };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  function emergencyPresetMarkup(preset) {
    if (preset === 'docs') return '<div class="em-top"><div class="em-logo">📄 Docs</div><div class="em-search">Document title</div></div><div class="em-document"><h1>Untitled document</h1><p>Notes</p><div class="em-line"></div><div class="em-line"></div><div class="em-line short"></div></div>';
    if (preset === 'wikipedia') return '<div class="em-wiki"><div class="em-top"><div class="em-logo">Wikipedia</div><div class="em-search">Search Wikipedia</div></div><div class="em-main"><h1>Wikipedia</h1><p>Welcome to Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia.</p><div class="em-line"></div><div class="em-line"></div><div class="em-line short"></div></div></div>';
    return '<div class="em-top"><div class="em-logo">🏫 Classroom</div><div class="em-search">Search classes</div></div><div class="em-main"><div class="em-heading">Classes</div><div class="em-grid"><div class="em-card"><strong>Mathematics</strong><span>Classwork and assignments</span></div><div class="em-card"><strong>English</strong><span>Course materials</span></div><div class="em-card"><strong>Science</strong><span>Announcements and resources</span></div></div></div>';
  }

  function activateEmergencyDisguise(auto) {
    if (_emergencyActive) return;
    const screen = document.getElementById('emergencyScreen');
    const preset = document.getElementById('emergencyPreset').value;
    _emergencyPreviousTitle = document.title;
    _emergencyPreviousIcon = document.querySelector("link[rel~='icon']")?.getAttribute('href') ?? null;
    const image = preset === 'custom' ? _settings.emergencyImage : null;
    screen.classList.toggle('custom-image', !!image);
    screen.style.backgroundImage = image ? 'url("' + image + '")' : '';
    screen.innerHTML = image ? '' : emergencyPresetMarkup(preset);
    screen.classList.add('active');
    screen.focus();
    screen.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    document.title = document.getElementById('emergencyTitle').value.trim() || EMERGENCY_PRESETS[preset]?.title || 'Document';
    emergencyIconLink().href = document.getElementById('emergencyIcon').value.trim() || EMERGENCY_PRESETS[preset]?.icon || '/favicon.ico';
    _emergencyActive = true;
    _emergencyAutoActivated = auto;
  }

  function deactivateEmergencyDisguise() {
    if (!_emergencyActive) return;
    const screen = document.getElementById('emergencyScreen');
    screen.classList.remove('active');
    screen.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.title = _emergencyPreviousTitle;
    const link = emergencyIconLink();
    if (_emergencyPreviousIcon === null) link.removeAttribute('href');
    else link.setAttribute('href', _emergencyPreviousIcon);
    _emergencyActive = false;
    _emergencyAutoActivated = false;
  }

  function emergencyKeydown(event) {
    if (_emergencyCapturingKey || (event.code || event.key) !== emergencyKeyCode() ||
        event.repeat || event.ctrlKey || event.altKey || event.metaKey) return;
    const target = event.target;
    if (target && (target.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(target.tagName))) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    if (_emergencyActive) deactivateEmergencyDisguise();
    else activateEmergencyDisguise(false);
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', emergencyKeydown, true);
  document.getElementById('gameFrame').addEventListener('load', function() {
    try { this.contentWindow.document.addEventListener('keydown', emergencyKeydown, true); }
    catch (err) { /* Other-origin game frames do not expose keyboard events. */ }
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
    if (document.hidden) {
      if (_settings.emergencyAuto && !_emergencyActive) activateEmergencyDisguise(true);
    } else if (_emergencyActive && _emergencyAutoActivated && !_settings.emergencyStay) {
      deactivateEmergencyDisguise();
    }
  });

  // ── Export / Import (whole account: progress, settings, and your ID) ────────────
  // Don't put the admin password or a shutdown bypass code into a shareable backup.
  const EXPORT_SKIP = { adminSecretRemember: 1, shutdownBypassCode: 1, adminShutdownDraft: 1 };
  function exportData() {
    const data = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < portableLocalStorage.length; i++) {
      const k = portableLocalStorage.key(i);
      if (EXPORT_SKIP[k]) continue;
      data[k] = portableLocalStorage.getItem(k);
    }
    // make sure the account ID travels with the backup, so your name/tier follow you
    let id = portableLocalStorage.getItem('siteVisitorId');
    if (!id) { id = (window.crypto && crypto.randomUUID) ? crypto.randomUUID() : (Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)); portableLocalStorage.setItem('siteVisitorId', id); }
    data.siteVisitorId = id;
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url  = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a    = document.createElement('a');
    a.href     = url;
    a.download = 'freeeducation-account.json';
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function handleImportFile(e) {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = ev => {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(ev.target.result);
        if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') throw new Error('bad');
        Object.entries(data).forEach(([k, v]) => { if (typeof v === 'string') portableLocalStorage.setItem(k, v); });
        alert('✅ Account imported! Reloading so your name, tier and progress take effect…');
        location.reload();
      } catch(err) { alert('❌ Invalid backup file.'); }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
    e.target.value = '';
  }

  // ── Apply all on load ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function applyAllSettings() {
    loadSettings();
    const s = _settings;

    if (s.accentColor) {
      applyAccentColor(s.accentColor);
    } else {
      syncSwatches('#00ffcc');
      document.getElementById('colorHexInput').value = '#00ffcc';
      document.getElementById('colorPickerNative').value = '#00ffcc';
    }

    applyLightMode(!!s.lightMode);
    applyHideImages(!!s.hideImages);

    if (s.tabTitle) {
      document.getElementById('tabTitleInput').value = s.tabTitle || '';
      setTabIcon(s.tabIcon || '');
      _tabDisguiseTitle  = s.tabTitle || '';
      _tabDisguiseIcon   = s.tabIcon  || '';
      _tabDisguiseActive = !!s.tabTitle;
      updateDocumentTitle();
      let link = document.querySelector("link[rel~='icon']");
      if (!link) { link = document.createElement('link'); link.rel = 'icon'; document.head.appendChild(link); }
      if (s.tabIcon) link.href = s.tabIcon;
    }
    renderCustomTabPresets();
    updateEmergencyKeyLabel();

    const preset = EMERGENCY_PRESETS[s.emergencyPreset] ? s.emergencyPreset : (s.emergencyPreset === 'custom' ? 'custom' : 'classroom');
    document.getElementById('emergencyPreset').value = preset;
    document.getElementById('emergencyTitle').value = s.emergencyTitle || EMERGENCY_PRESETS[preset]?.title || '';
    document.getElementById('emergencyIcon').value = s.emergencyIcon || EMERGENCY_PRESETS[preset]?.icon || '';
    document.getElementById('emergencyAuto').checked = !!s.emergencyAuto;
    document.getElementById('emergencyStay').checked = !!s.emergencyStay;
    document.getElementById('emergencyUploadStatus').textContent = s.emergencyImage ? 'Screenshot saved on this device.' : '';

    cpSyncFromHex(s.accentColor || '#00ffcc');
    cpInit();
  }
  </script>
  <!-- ============ ADMIN PANEL ============ -->
  <style>
    /* ---------- panel shell ---------- */
    #adminPanel {
      position: fixed; z-index: 501;
      width: 380px; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); max-height: 85vh;
      background: #0b0f16; border: 1px solid rgba(71,141,137,0.4);
      border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
      display: none; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden;
      font-size: 13px; color: #f9fafb; text-align: left;
    }
    #adminPanel.open { display: flex; }
    #adminPanel .admin-panel-body { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px; }

    /* Center: modal in the middle of the screen */
    #adminPanel.mode-center { top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }

    /* Corner: bottom-right, resizable with the grip in its top-left corner */
    #adminPanel.mode-corner { bottom: 16px; right: 16px; max-height: calc(100vh - 32px); min-width: 280px; min-height: 220px; }
    #adminResizeHandle {
      display: none; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 20px; height: 20px; z-index: 3;
      cursor: nwse-resize; border-top-left-radius: 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(148,163,184,0.75) 0 28%, transparent 28%);
    }
    #adminPanel.mode-corner #adminResizeHandle { display: block; }

    /* Tab: a full page inside the site, like Home / New Games */
    .admin-tab-host { width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; }
    #adminPanel.mode-tab {
      position: static; width: 100%; max-width: none; max-height: none;
      box-shadow: none; overflow: visible; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 18px);
    }
    #adminPanel.mode-tab .admin-panel-body { overflow: visible; padding: 20px; }

    #adminBackdrop { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); z-index: 499; }
    #adminBackdrop.show { display: block; }

    /* Minimized: small gear bottom-right */
    #adminMiniBtn {
      display: none; position: fixed; bottom: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 501;
      width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 999px; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(71,141,137,0.5); background: #0b0f16; color: #f9fafb;
      font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }
    #adminMiniBtn:hover { transform: scale(1.06); }

    /* ---------- panel contents ---------- */
    #adminPanel h3 { font-size: 15px; margin: 0; }
    #adminPanel h4 { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--accent-warm); margin: 14px 0 8px; }
    #adminPanel input[type="text"], #adminPanel input[type="password"], #adminPanel input[type="number"], #adminPanel textarea, #adminPanel select {
      width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.3);
      border-radius: 8px; color: #f9fafb; padding: 7px 9px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; outline: none; font-family: inherit;
    }
    #adminPanel select option { background: #0b0f16; }
    #adminPanel textarea { min-height: 70px; resize: vertical; }
    #adminPanel button {
      background: var(--accent-main); border: none; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff;
      padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; margin: 2px 4px 2px 0;
    }
    #adminPanel button.danger { background: #b91c1c; }
    #adminPanel button.ghost { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
    #adminPanel button:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
    #adminPanel code { font-size: 11px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

    #adminTopBar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-left: 6px; }
    #adminTopBarBtns { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
    #adminPanel .admin-icon-btn { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 9px; margin: 0; border-radius: 6px; }

    .admin-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    #adminPanel .admin-tab-btn {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.2); border-radius: 999px;
      color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; padding: 5px 11px; margin: 0;
    }
    #adminPanel .admin-tab-btn.active { background: var(--accent-main); color: #fff; border-color: transparent; }
    .admin-tab-content { display: none; }
    .admin-tab-content.active { display: block; }

    .admin-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
    .admin-metric-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.15); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; }
    .admin-metric-card .label { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .admin-metric-card .value { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px; }
    .admin-metric-card .sub { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-softer); min-height: 12px; }

    .admin-list { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .admin-list-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.08); }
    .admin-list-row > span:first-child { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .admin-list-row > span:last-child { white-space: nowrap; color: var(--text-softer); }
    .admin-tag { font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(71,141,137,0.3); color: #d1fae5; margin-left: 4px; }

    /* per-person moderation cards in the Live tab */
    /* visitors filters / grid */
    .admin-vfilters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    #adminPanel .admin-vfilter { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.2); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 9px; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; }
    #adminPanel .admin-vfilter.active { background: var(--accent-main); color: #fff; border-color: transparent; }
    .admin-vbar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 11px; }
    .admin-grid-pick { color: var(--text-muted); }
    #adminPanel .admin-grid-pick select { width: auto; margin: 0 0 0 4px; padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 11px; }
    .admin-visitors-grid { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
    .admin-visitors-grid.cols-1 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .admin-visitors-grid.cols-2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); }
    .admin-visitors-grid.cols-3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); }
    .admin-visitors-grid.cols-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr)); }
    .admin-visitors-grid .admin-person { margin-bottom: 0; }
    /* usage gauge */
    .usage-wrap { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.15); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; }
    .usage-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .usage-track { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 999px; height: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
    .usage-fill { height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent-main); transition: width .3s; }
    .usage-fill.warn { background: #eab308; }
    .usage-fill.over { background: #b91c1c; }
    .admin-person { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.15); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .admin-person-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .admin-person-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; }
    .admin-person-what { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .admin-person-rename { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; }
    .admin-person-rename .admin-rename-input { flex: 1; margin: 0; padding: 5px 8px; }
    #adminPanel .admin-person-rename button { margin: 0; padding: 5px 9px; }
    .admin-person-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-top: 8px; }
    .admin-shut-box { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center; margin-top: 10px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(185,28,28,0.35); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(185,28,28,0.08); }
    .admin-shut-box .admin-shut-input { flex: 1 1 160px; min-width: 120px; margin: 0; padding: 5px 8px; font-size: 12px; }
    #adminPanel .admin-shut-box button { margin: 0; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
    .admin-shut-box .admin-shut-live { flex: 1 1 100%; font-size: 12px; color: #fecaca; font-weight: 600; }
    .admin-shut-box .admin-shut-more { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-softer); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
    #adminPanel .admin-person-actions button { margin: 0; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }
    .admin-person-control { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-top: 8px; align-items: center; }
    #adminPanel .admin-person-control select { width: auto; max-width: 150px; margin: 0; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 11px; }
    #adminPanel .admin-person-control button { margin: 0; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }
    .admin-person-dm { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; }
    .admin-person-dm .admin-dm-input { flex: 1; margin: 0; padding: 5px 8px; }
    #adminPanel .admin-person-dm button { margin: 0; padding: 5px 10px; }
    .admin-person-role { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    #adminPanel .admin-person-role select { width: auto; margin: 0; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 11px; }
    .admin-person-perks { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; }
    .admin-person-perks label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
    #adminPanel .admin-person-perks input { width: auto; margin: 0; }
    .admin-snap-wrap { margin-top: 8px; position: relative; background: #05070c; border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.18); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
    img.admin-snap { display: none; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; background: #000; }
    .admin-snap-age { position: absolute; left: 6px; bottom: 4px; font-size: 10px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; }
    .admin-person-details { margin-top: 8px; }
    .admin-person-details > summary { cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-warm); list-style: revert; }
    .admin-detail-grid { margin-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.12); }
    .admin-detail { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 3px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.08); font-size: 11px; }
    .admin-detail-k { flex: 0 0 96px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .admin-detail-v { flex: 1; color: #e5e7eb; word-break: break-word; min-width: 0; }
    .admin-detail-v code { font-size: 10px; }
    .admin-ua { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-softer); }
    #adminPanel button.admin-copy { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: var(--text-muted); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 5px; margin: 0 0 0 4px; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; vertical-align: middle; }

    /* what a moderated visitor sees */
    #personalOverlay {
      display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9998; background: rgba(4,6,12,0.97); color: #f9fafb;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 30px; backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
    }
    #personalOverlay .p-box { max-width: 500px; }
    #personalOverlayIcon { font-size: 46px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    #personalOverlayText { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; }
    /* ===== unified notices (tips, announcements, per-person messages all share this look) ===== */
    /* rounded, translucent, a bit of the theme color — like the bar at the top of a game */
    .fe-notice {
      display: none; position: fixed; z-index: 10000; max-width: min(520px, 88vw);
      color: #fff; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: 14px;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-main) 82%, #0b0f16);
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-warm) 60%, transparent);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    /* positions (applied from the Notifications setting) */
    .fe-notice.pos-top    { top: 14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
    .fe-notice.pos-bottom { bottom: 14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
    .fe-notice.pos-left   { top: 14px; left: 14px; }
    .fe-notice.pos-right  { top: 14px; right: 14px; }
    #feToast { }
    /* persistent announcement banner — same look, with a close button */
    #announceBanner { padding-right: 40px; text-align: center; }
    #announceBannerText { white-space: pre-wrap; }
    #announceBannerClose {
      position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 8px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.28); border: none; color: #fff; border-radius: 999px;
      width: 22px; height: 22px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer;
    }
    /* read-only "Viewer" tier live panel */
    #viewerPanel {
      display: none; position: fixed; right: 14px; bottom: 14px; z-index: 498;
      width: 230px; max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto; background: #0b0f16; color: #f9fafb;
      border: 1px solid rgba(71,141,137,0.4); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); font-size: 12px;
    }
    #viewerHeader { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.15); font-weight: 600; }
    #viewerClose { background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
    #viewerBody { padding: 8px 10px; }
    #viewerBody .vrow { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 3px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.08); }
    #viewerBody .vrow span:last-child { color: var(--text-softer); white-space: nowrap; }
    #viewerBody .vcounts { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    #viewerBody .vpill { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 11px; }

    /* in-game hacks menu */
    #hacksBtn {
      display: none; position: fixed; right: 14px; bottom: 14px; z-index: 502;
      width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(147,51,234,0.6);
      background: #0b0f16; color: #fff; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }
    #hacksBtn:hover { transform: scale(1.06); }
    #hacksMenu {
      display: none; position: fixed; right: 14px; bottom: 70px; z-index: 502; width: 230px;
      background: #0b0f16; color: #f9fafb; border: 1px solid rgba(147,51,234,0.5); border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.65); font-size: 12px; overflow: hidden;
    }
    #hacksHeader { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.15); font-weight: 600; }
    #hacksHeader button { background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; }
    #hacksBody { padding: 10px; }
    .hacks-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .hacks-row input[type="range"] { flex: 1; }
    #hacksBody button { background: var(--accent-main); border: none; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
    .hacks-note { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-softer); line-height: 1.4; }

    .admin-bar-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr 30px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .admin-bar-track { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 999px; height: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
    .admin-bar { height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent-main); min-width: 2px; }
    .admin-bar-row b { text-align: right; color: #fff; }

    .admin-var-chip {
      display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; margin: 0 4px 4px 0; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.2); color: var(--text-muted); font-family: monospace;
    }
    .admin-var-chip:hover { color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent-main); }
    .admin-status-pill { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; }
    .admin-status-pill.on { background: rgba(22,163,74,0.2); color: #86efac; }
    .admin-status-pill.off { background: rgba(185,28,28,0.25); color: #fca5a5; }
    #adminPreview { font-size: 12px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35); border: 1px dashed rgba(148,163,184,0.25); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #e5e7eb; margin-bottom: 8px; min-height: 18px; }
    .admin-muted { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-softer); }
    .admin-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .admin-row label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; }
    #adminPanel .admin-row input[type="radio"], #adminPanel .admin-row input[type="checkbox"] { width: auto; margin: 0; }
    #adminPanel .admin-row input[type="number"] { width: 70px; margin: 0; }
    #adminPanel .admin-row select { width: auto; margin: 0; }
    #adminLoginMsg, #shutdownStatusMsg, #adminUpdatedAt { font-size: 11px; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* ---------- shutdown screen for visitors ---------- */
    #shutdownOverlay {
      display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9999; background: #000; color: #f9fafb;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 30px;
    }
    #shutdownOverlay .shutdown-box { max-width: 540px; }
    #shutdownOverlayText { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; }
    #shutdownCodeBox { display: none; margin-top: 26px; }
    #shutdownCodeBox .shutdown-code-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; }
    #shutdownCodeInput {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35); border-radius: 10px;
      color: #fff; padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 14px; outline: none; width: 220px; text-align: center;
    }
    #shutdownCodeBox button { background: var(--accent-main); border: none; border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; padding: 9px 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
    #shutdownCodeMsg { font-size: 12px; color: #fca5a5; margin-top: 8px; min-height: 14px; }

    /* ---------- small banner the admin sees while the site is off ---------- */
    #adminShutdownBanner {
      display: none; position: fixed; top: 8px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 600;
      background: #7f1d1d; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 6px 5px 14px; border-radius: 999px;
      align-items: center; gap: 10px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); white-space: nowrap;
    }
    #adminShutdownBanner button { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border: none; color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; }
  </style>

  <div id="adminBackdrop" onclick="minimizeAdminPanel()"></div>
  <button id="adminMiniBtn" onclick="expandAdminPanel()" title="Open admin panel">⚙</button>

  <div id="adminShutdownBanner">
    <span id="adminShutdownBannerText">🔒 Site is off for visitors</span>
    <button onclick="deactivateShutdown()">Turn back on</button>
  </div>

  <div id="adminPanel">
    <div id="adminResizeHandle" title="Drag to resize"></div>
    <div class="admin-panel-body">
      <div id="adminTopBar">
        <h3>🛠️ Admin Panel</h3>
        <div id="adminTopBarBtns">
          <button class="admin-icon-btn" id="adminMinBtn" onclick="minimizeAdminPanel()" title="Minimize to a small button in the corner">➖</button>
          <button class="admin-icon-btn" onclick="fullyCloseAdminPanel()" title="Close completely — type admin in the search bar to bring it back">✕</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="adminLoginView">
        <input type="password" id="adminPasswordInput" placeholder="Password" autocomplete="current-password" />
        <div class="admin-row">
          <label><input type="checkbox" id="rememberMeCheck" checked /> Remember me on this device</label>
        </div>
        <button onclick="attemptAdminLogin()">Unlock</button>
        <div id="adminLoginMsg"></div>
      </div>

      <div id="adminMainView" style="display:none;">
        <div class="admin-tabs">
          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-admintab="overview" onclick="showAdminTab('overview')">📊 Overview</button>
          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-admintab="visitors" onclick="showAdminTab('visitors')">👥 Live</button>
          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-admintab="analytics" onclick="showAdminTab('analytics')">📈 Analytics</button>
          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-admintab="announce" onclick="showAdminTab('announce')">📢 Announce</button>
          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-admintab="shutdown" onclick="showAdminTab('shutdown')">🔒 Shutdown</button>
          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-admintab="cheats" onclick="showAdminTab('cheats')">⛏️ Cheats</button>
          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-admintab="settings" onclick="showAdminTab('settings')">⚙️ Settings</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Overview -->
        <div class="admin-tab-content" data-admintabcontent="overview">
          <div class="admin-metrics" id="adminMetrics"></div>
          <h4>Most played today</h4>
          <div class="admin-list" id="adminTopGames">Loading...</div>
          <h4>Last 7 days</h4>
          <div id="adminWeekBars"></div>
          <div class="admin-row" style="margin-top:10px;justify-content:space-between;">
            <span id="adminUpdatedAt"></span>
            <button class="ghost" onclick="loadAnalytics()">Refresh</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Live visitors -->
        <div class="admin-tab-content" data-admintabcontent="visitors">
          <input type="text" id="visitorSearch" placeholder="🔍 Search name, nickname, ID, game…" oninput="renderVisitors()" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:8px;" />
          <div class="admin-vfilters" id="visitorFilters"></div>
          <div class="admin-vbar">
            <span class="admin-muted" id="visitorCountLabel"></span>
            <span class="admin-grid-pick">Per row:
              <select id="visitorCols" onchange="setVisitorCols(this.value)">
                <option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4">4</option>
              </select>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-list admin-visitors-grid" id="adminVisitorsList">Loading...</div>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-top:8px;">Live view refreshes every 2s; the list updates without losing your place.</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Analytics -->
        <div class="admin-tab-content" data-admintabcontent="analytics">
          <div id="usageGauge" style="margin-bottom:12px;"></div>
          <h4 style="margin-top:0;">Right now</h4>
          <div class="admin-metrics" id="anNowMetrics"></div>
          <h4>Where everyone is</h4>
          <div id="anStateBars"></div>
          <h4>Games being played now</h4>
          <div class="admin-list" id="anGamesNow"></div>
          <h4>Visitors</h4>
          <div class="admin-metrics" id="anVisitorMetrics"></div>
          <h4>Most played — today</h4>
          <div class="admin-list" id="anTopToday"></div>
          <h4>Most played — this week</h4>
          <div class="admin-list" id="anTopWeek"></div>
          <h4>Most played — this month</h4>
          <div class="admin-list" id="anTopMonth"></div>
          <h4>History</h4>
          <div class="admin-metrics" id="adminHistorySummary"></div>
          <h4>Visitors per day (last 14 days)</h4>
          <div id="adminHistoryBars"></div>
          <h4>Most played yesterday</h4>
          <div class="admin-list" id="adminTopGamesYesterday"></div>
          <div class="admin-row" style="margin-top:10px;justify-content:space-between;">
            <span id="anUpdatedAt" class="admin-muted"></span>
            <button class="ghost" onclick="loadAnalytics()">Refresh</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Announce -->
        <div class="admin-tab-content" data-admintabcontent="announce">
          <div id="broadcastStatusBar" style="margin-bottom:10px;"></div>
          <h4 style="margin-top:0;">📢 Announce to everyone</h4>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-bottom:6px;">Shows as a banner (appears within a few seconds, no refresh). They can dismiss it with ✕.</div>
          <h4 style="margin-top:0;">Who to announce to</h4>
          <div class="admin-row">
            <select id="annWhoType" onchange="onAnnWhoChange()">
              <option value="all">Everyone</option>
              <option value="anygame">Anyone in a game</option>
              <option value="game">People on a specific game…</option>
              <option value="state:playing">People playing (not idle)</option>
              <option value="state:idle">Idle people</option>
              <option value="state:othertab">People on another tab</option>
              <option value="nick">People I nicknamed</option>
              <option value="person">One person (by ID)…</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-row" id="annWhoExtra" style="display:none;"></div>
          <div id="annRulesList" style="margin:6px 0;"></div>
          <h4 style="margin-top:0;">Message</h4>
          <textarea id="broadcastMessage" placeholder="e.g. New games added! Check the New Games tab."></textarea>
          <h4>How long</h4>
          <div class="admin-row">
            <label><input type="radio" name="announceDuration" value="timed" checked /> For</label>
            <input type="number" id="announceAmount" value="10" min="1" step="1" />
            <select id="announceUnit">
              <option value="minutes">minutes</option>
              <option value="hours">hours</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-row">
            <label><input type="radio" name="announceDuration" value="indefinite" /> Until I turn it off</label>
          </div>
          <div style="margin-top:8px;">
            <button onclick="sendBroadcast()">Send to everyone</button>
            <button class="ghost" onclick="clearBroadcast()">Turn off</button>
          </div>
          <div id="broadcastStatus" class="admin-muted" style="margin-top:4px;"></div>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-top:10px;line-height:1.5;">To announce to <b>one person</b> instead, use the message box on their card in the Live tab.</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Shutdown -->
        <div class="admin-tab-content" data-admintabcontent="shutdown">
          <div id="adminShutdownStatus" style="margin-bottom:10px;"></div>

          <h4 style="margin-top:0;">Who to shut down</h4>
          <div class="admin-row">
            <select id="shutWhoType" onchange="onShutWhoChange()">
              <option value="all">Everyone</option>
              <option value="anygame">Anyone in a game</option>
              <option value="game">People on a specific game…</option>
              <option value="state:playing">People playing (not idle)</option>
              <option value="state:idle">Idle people</option>
              <option value="state:othertab">People on another tab</option>
              <option value="nick">People I nicknamed</option>
              <option value="person">One person (by ID)…</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-row" id="shutWhoExtra" style="display:none;"></div>
          <div id="shutRulesList" style="margin:6px 0;"></div>

          <h4 style="margin-top:0;">Message they see</h4>
          <textarea id="shutdownMessage" placeholder="e.g. {site_name} is down for {reason}. Back in {time_left}!"></textarea>
          <div id="adminVarChips"></div>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-bottom:4px;">Preview:</div>
          <div id="adminPreview"></div>

          <input type="text" id="shutdownReason" placeholder="Reason (fills {reason}, optional)" />

          <h4>Access code</h4>
          <input type="text" id="shutdownCode" placeholder="Optional — people who type this code can still get in" autocomplete="off" />

          <h4>How long</h4>
          <div class="admin-row">
            <label><input type="radio" name="shutdownDuration" value="timed" checked /> For</label>
            <input type="number" id="shutdownAmount" value="30" min="1" step="1" />
            <select id="shutdownUnit">
              <option value="minutes">minutes</option>
              <option value="hours">hours</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-row">
            <label><input type="radio" name="shutdownDuration" value="indefinite" /> Until I turn it back on</label>
          </div>

          <div style="margin-top:8px;">
            <button onclick="activateShutdown()" class="danger" id="shutdownGoBtn">Shut down site</button>
            <button onclick="deactivateShutdown()">Turn back on</button>
          </div>
          <div id="adminExtendBtns" style="display:none;margin-top:4px;">
            <button class="ghost" onclick="extendShutdown(5)">+5 min</button>
            <button class="ghost" onclick="extendShutdown(15)">+15 min</button>
            <button class="ghost" onclick="extendShutdown(60)">+1 hour</button>
          </div>
          <div id="shutdownStatusMsg"></div>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-top:6px;">You (logged in as admin) can always still use the site while it's off.</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Cheats -->
        <div class="admin-tab-content" data-admintabcontent="cheats">
          <h4 style="margin-top:0;">Games with a cheat client</h4>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-bottom:6px;">Turn one on and opening that game loads the cheat version (for you / anyone with the Game-hacks perk). Everyone else gets the normal game.</div>
          <div class="admin-list" id="cheatClientList"></div>
          <div class="admin-muted" id="cheatStatus" style="line-height:1.5;margin-top:6px;"></div>

          <h4>Global cheats</h4>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-bottom:6px;">These affect whatever game you have open right now (experimental — works on many games, not all).</div>
          <div id="cheatGlobals">
            <label class="hacks-row">⏩ Speed
              <input type="range" id="cgSpeed" min="0.25" max="8" step="0.25" value="1" oninput="applyHackSpeed(this.value)">
              <span id="cgSpeedVal">1x</span>
            </label>
            <label class="hacks-row">🔍 Zoom
              <input type="range" id="cgZoom" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.1" value="1" oninput="applyHackZoom(this.value)">
              <span id="cgZoomVal">1x</span>
            </label>
            <div class="hacks-row">
              <label><input type="checkbox" id="cgAuto" onchange="toggleAutoClick(this.checked)"> 🖱️ Auto-click</label>
              <input type="number" id="cgCps" min="1" max="50" value="10" style="width:52px;" oninput="updateAutoClickRate(this.value)"> /s
            </div>
            <div class="hacks-row">
              <label><input type="checkbox" id="cgMute" onchange="toggleHackMute(this.checked)"> 🔇 Mute game</label>
              <button onclick="toggleHackPause()" id="cgPauseBtn">⏸ Freeze</button>
              <button onclick="hackScreenshot()">📸 Screenshot</button>
              <button class="ghost" onclick="resetHacks()">↺ Reset</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <h4>Where to get cheat clients</h4>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="line-height:1.7;">
            Add a game by dropping a modded <code>hacked.html</code> into its folder, then add its name to the list in the code.
            Eaglercraft (Minecraft): GitHub <b>"eaglercraft hacked client"</b> / <code>EaglerClientArchive</code>. Other games:
            <b>GitHub</b> (game name + "mod"/"hacked"), <b>GreasyFork</b> userscripts, unblocked-games "hacked" repos.
            <br><span style="color:#fca5a5;">⚠ Vet anything you download — "cheat client" files can hide malware. Open it yourself once first.</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Settings -->
        <div class="admin-tab-content" data-admintabcontent="settings">
          <h4 style="margin-top:0;">Where the panel shows up</h4>
          <div class="admin-row"><label><input type="radio" name="panelMode" value="center" onchange="setPanelMode('center')" /> Center of the screen</label></div>
          <div class="admin-row"><label><input type="radio" name="panelMode" value="corner" onchange="setPanelMode('corner')" /> Corner (drag the top-left grip to resize)</label></div>
          <div class="admin-row"><label><input type="radio" name="panelMode" value="tab" onchange="setPanelMode('tab')" /> Tab (an "Admin" tab next to Home / Chat)</label></div>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-bottom:10px;">Remembered on this device.</div>

          <h4>On page refresh</h4>
          <div class="admin-row"><label><input type="checkbox" id="autoOpenCheck" onchange="setAutoOpen(this.checked)" /> Auto-show the admin button when I reload (so I don't have to type admin again)</label></div>

          <h4>Account</h4>
          <button class="ghost" onclick="logoutAdmin()">Log out / forget password on this device</button>

          <h4>Donations (the ❤️ Donate tab)</h4>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-bottom:8px;">Update how much you've raised this month — the goal bar on the Donate tab fills to match. Resets to $0 automatically each month.</div>
          <div class="admin-row" style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">
            <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;">Raised this month $<input type="number" id="donateRaisedInput" min="0" step="0.5" style="width:90px;margin:0;padding:5px 7px;" /></label>
            <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;">Goal $<input type="number" id="donateGoalInput" min="1" step="1" style="width:70px;margin:0;padding:5px 7px;" /></label>
            <button onclick="saveDonate()">Save</button>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-muted" id="donateAdminMsg" style="margin-top:6px;"></div>
          <div class="admin-muted" style="margin-top:4px;">Ko-fi link: edit <code>KOFI_NAME</code> near the top of the site script (search it in index.html).</div>

          <h4>Data</h4>
          <button class="ghost" onclick="resetAdminStats()">Reset all visitor stats</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Full-page shutdown screen, only shown to visitors while the site is off -->
  <div id="shutdownOverlay">
    <div class="shutdown-box">
      <div style="font-size:44px;margin-bottom:14px;">🛠️</div>
      <div id="shutdownOverlayText"></div>
      <div id="shutdownCodeBox">
        <div class="shutdown-code-row">
          <input type="text" id="shutdownCodeInput" placeholder="Have an access code?" autocomplete="off" />
          <button onclick="submitBypassCode()">Enter</button>
        </div>
        <div id="shutdownCodeMsg"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Per-person screen, only shown to a visitor the admin has paused or blocked -->
  <div id="personalOverlay">
    <div class="p-box">
      <div id="personalOverlayIcon">⏸️</div>
      <div id="personalOverlayText"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Little popup for admin messages / notices to a visitor -->
  <div id="feToast" class="fe-notice pos-top"></div>

  <!-- Persistent announcement banner (shown to everyone until it expires or they dismiss it) -->
  <div id="announceBanner" class="fe-notice pos-top">
    <span id="announceBannerText"></span>
    <button id="announceBannerClose" onclick="dismissAnnounce()" title="Dismiss">✕</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Read-only live view for "Viewer" tier users (no controls) -->
  <div id="viewerPanel">
    <div id="viewerHeader"><span>👁 Live</span><button id="viewerClose" onclick="closeViewerPanel()" title="Hide">✕</button></div>
    <div id="viewerBody"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- In-game hacks (shown only while a granted user is in a game) -->
  <button id="hacksBtn" onclick="toggleHacksMenu()" title="Game hacks">🎮</button>
  <div id="hacksMenu">
    <div id="hacksHeader"><span>🎮 Game Hacks</span><button onclick="toggleHacksMenu()" title="Close">✕</button></div>
    <div id="hacksBody">
      <label class="hacks-row">⏩ Speed
        <input type="range" id="hackSpeed" min="0.25" max="8" step="0.25" value="1" oninput="applyHackSpeed(this.value)">
        <span id="hackSpeedVal">1x</span>
      </label>
      <div class="hacks-row">
        <button id="hackPauseBtn" onclick="toggleHackPause()">⏸ Freeze</button>
        <button onclick="resetHacks()">↺ Reset all</button>
      </div>
      <label class="hacks-row">🔍 Zoom
        <input type="range" id="hackZoom" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.1" value="1" oninput="applyHackZoom(this.value)">
        <span id="hackZoomVal">1x</span>
      </label>
      <div class="hacks-row">
        <label><input type="checkbox" id="hackAutoClick" onchange="toggleAutoClick(this.checked)"> 🖱️ Auto-click</label>
        <input type="number" id="hackCps" min="1" max="50" value="10" style="width:52px;" oninput="updateAutoClickRate(this.value)"> /s
      </label>
      <div class="hacks-row">
        <label><input type="checkbox" id="hackMute" onchange="toggleHackMute(this.checked)"> 🔇 Mute game</label>
        <button onclick="hackScreenshot()">📸 Screenshot</button>
      </div>
      <div id="hackCheatRow" style="display:none;">
        <label class="hacks-row"><input type="checkbox" id="hackCheatToggle" onchange="toggleCheatFromHacks(this.checked)"> ⚡ <span id="hackCheatLabel">Cheat version</span></label>
      </div>
      <div class="hacks-note">Speed, freeze, zoom, auto-click & mute work on many games but not all — they're experimental.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    (function() {
      const SITE_NAME = 'Free Education';
      const $ = function(id) { return document.getElementById(id); };

      // ---------- small helpers ----------
      function escapeHtml(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
          return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c];
        });
      }
      function lsGet(k) { try { return portableLocalStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) { return null; } }
      function lsSet(k, v) { try { portableLocalStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch (e) {} }
      function lsDel(k) { try { portableLocalStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (e) {} }
      function ssGet(k) { try { return portableSessionStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) { return null; } }
      function ssSet(k, v) { try { portableSessionStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch (e) {} }
      function ssDel(k) { try { portableSessionStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (e) {} }
      function uuid() {
        return (window.crypto && crypto.randomUUID) ? crypto.randomUUID() : (Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
      }
      function userTz() { try { return Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || ''; } catch (e) { return ''; } }

      function formatTimeLeft(ms) {
        if (ms == null) return '';
        if (ms <= 0) return '0:00';
        const t = Math.ceil(ms / 1000);
        const d = Math.floor(t / 86400), h = Math.floor((t % 86400) / 3600), m = Math.floor((t % 3600) / 60), s = t % 60;
        const p = function(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); };
        if (d > 0) return d + 'd ' + h + ':' + p(m) + ':' + p(s);
        return h > 0 ? (h + ':' + p(m) + ':' + p(s)) : (m + ':' + p(s));
      }
      function fmtDuration(ms) {
        const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000));
        const h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60), sec = s % 60;
        if (h) return h + 'h ' + m + 'm';
        if (m) return m + 'm ' + sec + 's';
        return sec + 's';
      }
      function dayLabel(key) {
        const parts = String(key).split('-').map(Number);
        const d = new Date(parts[0], parts[1] - 1, parts[2]);
        return d.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
      }

      // ---------- message variables ----------
      const TEMPLATE_VARS = ['time_left', 'minutes_left', 'hours_left', 'end_time', 'end_date', 'reason', 'site_name', 'visitor_count', 'current_time', 'today_date', 'day_name'];
      function renderTemplate(tmpl, st, nowMs) {
        const now = new Date(nowMs);
        const end = st.endTime ? new Date(st.endTime) : null;
        const left = st.endTime ? Math.max(0, st.endTime - nowMs) : null;
        const vars = {
          time_left: left != null ? formatTimeLeft(left) : 'an unknown amount of time',
          minutes_left: left != null ? String(Math.ceil(left / 60000)) : 'unknown',
          hours_left: left != null ? (left / 3600000).toFixed(1) : 'unknown',
          end_time: end ? end.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }) : 'an unknown time',
          end_date: end ? end.toLocaleDateString() : 'an unknown date',
          reason: st.reason || 'maintenance',
          site_name: SITE_NAME,
          visitor_count: st.visitorCount != null ? String(st.visitorCount) : '?',
          current_time: now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }),
          today_date: now.toLocaleDateString(),
          day_name: now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'long' }),
        };
        return String(tmpl || '').replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, function(m, k) {
          return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(vars, k) ? vars[k] : m;
        });
      }

      // ---------- login ("remember me" = portableLocalStorage, otherwise just this tab) ----------
      function getAdminSecret() { return lsGet('adminSecretRemember') || ssGet('adminSecret') || ''; }
      function setAdminSecret(v, remember) {
        if (remember) { lsSet('adminSecretRemember', v); ssDel('adminSecret'); }
        else { ssSet('adminSecret', v); lsDel('adminSecretRemember'); }
      }
      function clearAdminSecret() { lsDel('adminSecretRemember'); ssDel('adminSecret'); }
      function isLoggedIn() { return !!getAdminSecret(); }
      function adminHeaders(secret) {
        const h = { 'X-Admin-Secret': secret || getAdminSecret() };
        const tz = userTz(); if (tz) h['X-Admin-TZ'] = tz;
        return h;
      }

      // ---------- panel position / open state ----------
      let panelState = 'closed';   // for center/corner: 'open' | 'minimized' | 'closed'
      let adminTabActive = false;  // for tab mode: admin page is showing
      let fullyClosed = false;     // ✕ pressed: hide everything until "admin" is typed again

      function getPanelMode() {
        const m = lsGet('adminPanelMode');
        return (m === 'corner' || m === 'tab' || m === 'center') ? m : 'center';
      }

      function renderPanel() {
        const panel = $('adminPanel'), host = $('adminTabHost'), backdrop = $('adminBackdrop');
        const mini = $('adminMiniBtn'), navTab = $('adminNavTab'), minBtn = $('adminMinBtn');
        if (!panel) return;
        const mode = getPanelMode();

        panel.classList.remove('mode-corner', 'mode-tab', 'mode-center');
        panel.classList.add('mode-' + mode);

        // tab mode lives inside the page, the others float on top of it
        if (mode === 'tab' && host) {
          if (panel.parentElement !== host) host.appendChild(panel);
        } else if (panel.parentElement !== document.body) {
          document.body.appendChild(panel);
        }

        if (mode === 'corner') {
          const w = parseInt(lsGet('adminPanelW'), 10), h = parseInt(lsGet('adminPanelH'), 10);
          panel.style.width = w ? Math.min(w, window.innerWidth - 32) + 'px' : '';
          panel.style.height = h ? Math.min(h, window.innerHeight - 32) + 'px' : '';
        } else {
          panel.style.width = '';
          panel.style.height = '';
        }

        if (mode === 'tab') {
          panel.classList.toggle('open', adminTabActive);
          if (host) host.style.display = adminTabActive ? 'block' : 'none';
          backdrop.classList.remove('show');
          mini.style.display = 'none';
        } else {
          if (host) host.style.display = 'none';
          panel.classList.toggle('open', panelState === 'open');
          backdrop.classList.toggle('show', mode === 'center' && panelState === 'open');
          mini.style.display = panelState === 'minimized' ? 'flex' : 'none';
        }
        if (minBtn) minBtn.style.display = mode === 'tab' ? 'none' : '';

        if (navTab) {
          const show = mode === 'tab' && !fullyClosed && (isLoggedIn() || adminTabActive);
          navTab.style.display = show ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
          navTab.classList.toggle('active', adminTabActive);
        }

        const radio = document.querySelector('input[name="panelMode"][value="' + mode + '"]');
        if (radio) radio.checked = true;
      }

      // Tab mode: hide the normal site sections and show the admin page instead
      const SITE_SECTION_IDS = ['homePanel', 'suggestionsPanel', 'linksPanel', 'placeholderPanel', 'categoriesPanel', 'chatPanel', 'donatePanel', 'categoryBackBar', 'cardsRow', 'gameToolsRow', 'searchBox'];
      function enterAdminTabPage() {
        adminTabActive = true;
        SITE_SECTION_IDS.forEach(function(id) { const el = $(id); if (el) el.style.display = 'none'; });
        document.querySelectorAll('.filter-pill').forEach(function(p) { if (p.id !== 'adminNavTab') p.classList.remove('active'); });
        renderPanel();
      }
      function leaveAdminTabPage() {
        if (!adminTabActive) return;
        adminTabActive = false;
        if (typeof window.updateViewForFilter === 'function') window.updateViewForFilter(); // back to whatever you were on
        renderPanel();
      }

      // Any normal tab click (Home, New Games...) closes the admin page
      if (typeof window.updateViewForFilter === 'function') {
        const origUpdateView = window.updateViewForFilter;
        window.updateViewForFilter = function() {
          adminTabActive = false;
          const r = origUpdateView.apply(this, arguments);
          renderPanel();
          return r;
        };
      }

      window.openAdminPanel = function() {
        fullyClosed = false;
        if (getPanelMode() === 'tab') {
          enterAdminTabPage();
          try { window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); } catch (e) {}
        } else {
          panelState = 'open';
          renderPanel();
        }
        refreshPanelContent();
      };

      // ➖ : shrink to the gear in the corner (tab mode: go back to the site)
      window.minimizeAdminPanel = function() {
        if (getPanelMode() === 'tab') { leaveAdminTabPage(); return; }
        if (panelState !== 'open') return;
        panelState = 'minimized';
        renderPanel();
      };
      window.expandAdminPanel = function() {
        if (getPanelMode() === 'tab') { enterAdminTabPage(); return; }
        panelState = 'open';
        renderPanel();
        if (isLoggedIn()) loadAnalytics();
      };
      // ✕ : gone completely (no gear, no tab) until "admin" is typed in search again
      window.fullyCloseAdminPanel = function() {
        fullyClosed = true;
        panelState = 'closed';
        if (adminTabActive) leaveAdminTabPage();
        renderPanel();
      };
      window.closeAdminPanel = window.fullyCloseAdminPanel;

      window.setPanelMode = function(mode) {
        const wasTab = adminTabActive;
        lsSet('adminPanelMode', mode);
        if (mode === 'tab') {
          panelState = 'closed';
          enterAdminTabPage();
        } else {
          panelState = 'open';
          if (wasTab) {
            adminTabActive = false;
            if (typeof window.updateViewForFilter === 'function') window.updateViewForFilter();
          }
          renderPanel();
        }
      };

      // Corner resize grip (top-left, since the panel is pinned bottom-right)
      (function setupResize() {
        const handle = $('adminResizeHandle'), panel = $('adminPanel');
        if (!handle || !panel) return;
        handle.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e) {
          if (getPanelMode() !== 'corner') return;
          e.preventDefault();
          const startX = e.clientX, startY = e.clientY, startW = panel.offsetWidth, startH = panel.offsetHeight;
          try { handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
          function move(ev) {
            const w = Math.min(Math.max(startW + (startX - ev.clientX), 280), window.innerWidth - 32);
            const h = Math.min(Math.max(startH + (startY - ev.clientY), 220), window.innerHeight - 32);
            panel.style.width = w + 'px';
            panel.style.height = h + 'px';
          }
          function up() {
            handle.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
            handle.removeEventListener('pointerup', up);
            handle.removeEventListener('pointercancel', up);
            lsSet('adminPanelW', String(panel.offsetWidth));
            lsSet('adminPanelH', String(panel.offsetHeight));
          }
          handle.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
          handle.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
          handle.addEventListener('pointercancel', up);
        });
        window.addEventListener('resize', function() { if (getPanelMode() === 'corner') renderPanel(); });
      })();

      // Secret way in: type "admin" in the search bar
      const searchTriggerEl = $('searchInput');
      if (searchTriggerEl) {
        searchTriggerEl.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
          if (e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase() === 'admin') {
            e.target.value = '';
            if (typeof createCards === 'function') createCards();
            e.target.blur();
            openAdminPanel();
          }
        });
      }

      // ---------- login ----------
      function refreshPanelContent() {
        const loggedIn = isLoggedIn();
        $('adminLoginView').style.display = loggedIn ? 'none' : 'block';
        $('adminMainView').style.display = loggedIn ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (loggedIn) {
          showAdminTab(lsGet('adminLastTab') || 'overview');
          loadAnalytics();
        } else {
          setTimeout(function() { const i = $('adminPasswordInput'); if (i) i.focus(); }, 60);
        }
        renderPanel();
      }

      window.attemptAdminLogin = async function() {
        const input = $('adminPasswordInput'), msg = $('adminLoginMsg');
        const raw = input.value;
        const remember = $('rememberMeCheck') ? $('rememberMeCheck').checked : true;
        const candidates = [raw, raw.trim()].filter(function(v, i, a) { return v && a.indexOf(v) === i; });
        if (!candidates.length) { msg.textContent = 'Type the password first.'; return; }
        msg.textContent = 'Checking...';
        try {
          for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
            const res = await fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/analytics', { headers: adminHeaders(candidates[i]), cache: 'no-store' });
            if (res.ok) {
              setAdminSecret(candidates[i], remember);
              input.value = '';
              msg.textContent = '';
              refreshPanelContent();
              pollNow();
              return;
            }
            if (res.status !== 401) { msg.textContent = 'Server error (' + res.status + ') — check the latest Cloudflare deploy finished.'; return; }
          }
          msg.textContent = 'Incorrect password.';
        } catch (e) {
          msg.textContent = 'Could not reach the admin API.';
        }
      };
      $('adminPasswordInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') attemptAdminLogin(); });

      window.logoutAdmin = function() {
        clearAdminSecret();
        lsDel('eaglerCheatsEnabled');
        refreshPanelContent();
        pollNow();
      };

      async function adminPost(path, body) {
        const res = await fetch(path, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, adminHeaders()),
          body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
          cache: 'no-store',
        });
        let data = null;
        try { data = await res.json(); } catch (e) {}
        if (res.status === 401) {
          clearAdminSecret();
          refreshPanelContent();
          $('adminLoginMsg').textContent = 'Your saved password stopped working — log in again.';
        }
        return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, data: data };
      }

      // ---------- sub tabs ----------
      window.showAdminTab = function(name) {
        if (!document.querySelector('.admin-tab-btn[data-admintab="' + name + '"]')) name = 'overview';
        lsSet('adminLastTab', name);
        document.querySelectorAll('.admin-tab-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.admintab === name); });
        document.querySelectorAll('.admin-tab-content').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.toggle('active', c.dataset.admintabcontent === name); });
        if (name === 'cheats') syncCheatsUI();
        if (name === 'shutdown') renderShutdownAdmin();
        if (name === 'announce') { renderBroadcastAdmin(); loadRules(); }
        if (name === 'shutdown') loadRules();
        if (name === 'visitors') renderVisitors();
        if (name === 'analytics' && lastAnalytics) renderAnalyticsTab(lastAnalytics);
        if (name === 'settings') loadDonateAdmin();
      };

      // ---------- analytics ----------
      let lastAnalytics = null;
      const PAGE_NAMES = { home: 'Home', popular: 'Popular', new: 'New Games', all: 'All Games A–Z', suggestions: 'Suggestions', links: 'Links', placeholder: 'Web', chat: 'Chat', categories: 'Categories', admin: 'Admin panel' };
      const MOD_LABELS = { pause: 'screen shut', block: 'screen shut', nogames: 'no games' };
      const STATE_LABELS = {
        playing:     '🎮 Playing',
        'game-idle': '🎮 In game · not touching it',
        'game-bg':   '🎮 Game open · on another tab',
        browsing:    '📄 On the site',
        'page-idle': '📄 On the site · not touching it',
        'other-tab': '🔀 Tab open · on another tab',
        offline:     '⚫ Offline',
      };
      const ROLE_LABELS = { vip: '⭐ VIP', viewer: '👁 Viewer' };
      // which filter bucket a state belongs to
      function stateGroup(st) {
        if (st === 'offline') return 'offline';
        if (st === 'playing' || st === 'game-idle') return 'playing';
        if (st === 'other-tab' || st === 'game-bg') return 'othertab';
        if (st === 'page-idle') return 'idle';
        return 'onsite';
      }

      // country code -> flag emoji
      function flagOf(cc) {
        if (!cc || cc.length !== 2 || !/^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(cc)) return '';
        return String.fromCodePoint.apply(null, cc.toUpperCase().split('').map(function(c) { return 0x1F1E6 + c.charCodeAt(0) - 65; }));
      }
      // rough browser / OS / device from a user-agent string
      function parseUA(ua) {
        ua = ua || '';
        let os = 'Unknown OS', br = 'Unknown browser', dev = 'Desktop';
        if (/Windows NT 10/.test(ua)) os = 'Windows 10/11';
        else if (/Windows NT/.test(ua)) os = 'Windows';
        else if (/CrOS/.test(ua)) os = 'ChromeOS';
        else if (/Android/.test(ua)) { os = 'Android'; dev = 'Phone/Tablet'; }
        else if (/iPhone/.test(ua)) { os = 'iOS'; dev = 'iPhone'; }
        else if (/iPad/.test(ua)) { os = 'iPadOS'; dev = 'iPad'; }
        else if (/Mac OS X/.test(ua)) os = 'macOS';
        else if (/Linux/.test(ua)) os = 'Linux';
        if (/Edg\//.test(ua)) br = 'Edge';
        else if (/OPR\//.test(ua) || /Opera/.test(ua)) br = 'Opera';
        else if (/SamsungBrowser/.test(ua)) br = 'Samsung Internet';
        else if (/Chrome\//.test(ua)) br = 'Chrome';
        else if (/Firefox\//.test(ua)) br = 'Firefox';
        else if (/Safari\//.test(ua)) br = 'Safari';
        if (/Mobile/.test(ua) && dev === 'Desktop') dev = 'Phone';
        return { os: os, browser: br, device: dev };
      }
      function copyToClip(text) {
        try { if (navigator.clipboard) { navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); showToast('Copied: ' + text); return; } } catch (e) {}
        showToast(text);
      }
      window.__adminCopy = copyToClip;

      let toastTimer = null;
      function showToast(text, ms) {
        const t = $('feToast'); if (!t) return;
        t.textContent = text;
        t.style.display = 'block';
        clearTimeout(toastTimer);
        toastTimer = setTimeout(function() { t.style.display = 'none'; }, ms || 5000);
      }
      // where all notices (tips / announcements / messages) appear — shared by every notice
      window.applyNoticePos = function() {
        const pos = lsGet('noticePos') || 'top';
        const cls = 'pos-' + (['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right'].indexOf(pos) >= 0 ? pos : 'top');
        ['feToast', 'announceBanner'].forEach(function(id) {
          const el = $(id); if (!el) return;
          el.classList.remove('pos-top', 'pos-bottom', 'pos-left', 'pos-right');
          el.classList.add(cls);
        });
      };
      window.setNoticePos = function(pos) { lsSet('noticePos', pos); applyNoticePos(); };

      function panelVisible() {
        return isLoggedIn() && (getPanelMode() === 'tab' ? adminTabActive : panelState === 'open');
      }

      function barsHtml(rows) {
        const max = Math.max.apply(null, [1].concat(rows.map(function(r) { return r.value; })));
        return rows.map(function(r) {
          return '<div class="admin-bar-row"><span>' + escapeHtml(r.label) + '</span><div class="admin-bar-track"><div class="admin-bar" style="width:' +
            (r.value / max * 100).toFixed(1) + '%"></div></div><b>' + escapeHtml(r.value) + '</b></div>';
        }).join('');
      }
      function metricCards(cards) {
        return cards.map(function(c) {
          return '<div class="admin-metric-card"><div class="label">' + escapeHtml(c[0]) + '</div><div class="value">' + escapeHtml(c[1]) +
            '</div><div class="sub">' + escapeHtml(c[2] || '') + '</div></div>';
        }).join('');
      }
      function gamesList(list) {
        if (!list || !list.length) return '<div class="admin-muted">No games played yet.</div>';
        return list.map(function(g, i) {
          return '<div class="admin-list-row"><span>' + (i + 1) + '. ' + escapeHtml(g.game) + '</span><span>' + escapeHtml(g.plays) + ' play' + (g.plays === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</span></div>';
        }).join('');
      }

      // ----- coordinator: loadAnalytics calls this with the server data -----
      function renderAnalytics(d) {
        renderOverview(d);
        renderVisitors();      // reads lastAnalytics (set by loadAnalytics before this)
        renderAnalyticsTab(d);
        renderHistory(d);
      }

      function renderOverview(d) {
        const now = d.serverNow || Date.now();
        const days = d.last14Days || [];
        const today = days[0] || { visits: 0, newVisitors: 0 };
        $('adminMetrics').innerHTML = metricCards([
          ['Online now', d.onlineNow || 0, 'on the tab right now'],
          ['Playing a game', d.playingNow || 0, 'on a game right now'],
          ['Idle / other tab', d.otherTabNow || 0, 'tab open, switched away'],
          ['On site, no game', d.onSiteNotGame || 0, 'on a page right now'],
          ['Offline (known)', d.offlineCount || 0, 'played before, not on now'],
          ['Visitors today', d.visitorsToday || today.visits || 0, (d.newToday || 0) + ' first-time'],
          ['All-time visitors', d.uniqueVisitorsAllTime || 0, (d.totalVisitsAllTime || 0) + ' visits total'],
        ]);
        $('adminTopGames').innerHTML = gamesList(d.topGamesToday);
        $('adminWeekBars').innerHTML = barsHtml(days.slice(0, 7).reverse().map(function(x) { return { label: dayLabel(x.date), value: x.visits }; }));
        if ($('adminUpdatedAt')) $('adminUpdatedAt').textContent = 'Updated ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString() + (d.timeZone ? ' · days in ' + d.timeZone : '');
      }

      function renderHistory(d) {
        const days = d.last14Days || [];
        const twoWeeks = days.reduce(function(a, x) { return a + x.visits; }, 0);
        const busiest = days.reduce(function(b, x) { return x.visits > (b ? b.visits : -1) ? x : b; }, null);
        $('adminHistorySummary').innerHTML = metricCards([
          ['Last 14 days', twoWeeks, 'daily visitors added up'],
          ['Daily average', days.length ? Math.round(twoWeeks / days.length) : 0, 'last 14 days'],
          ['Busiest day', busiest ? busiest.visits : 0, busiest ? dayLabel(busiest.date) : ''],
          ['First-time visitors', days.reduce(function(a, x) { return a + (x.newVisitors || 0); }, 0), 'last 14 days'],
        ]);
        $('adminHistoryBars').innerHTML = barsHtml(days.slice().reverse().map(function(x) { return { label: dayLabel(x.date), value: x.visits }; }));
        $('adminTopGamesYesterday').innerHTML = gamesList(d.topGamesYesterday);
      }

      // ----- the detailed Analytics tab -----
      const STATE_ROW_LABELS = {
        playing: '🎮 Playing a game',
        'game-idle': '🎮 In a game but idle',
        'game-bg': '🎮 Game open, on another tab',
        browsing: '📄 On the site (a page)',
        'page-idle': '📄 On the site but idle',
        'other-tab': '🔀 Tab open, on another tab',
      };
      function renderAnalyticsTab(d) {
        // usage gauge
        const u = d.usage || { apiRequestsToday: 0, limit: 100000, resetsAt: 0 };
        const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((u.apiRequestsToday / (u.limit || 100000)) * 100));
        const cls = pct >= 100 ? 'over' : (pct >= 80 ? 'warn' : '');
        const resetTxt = u.resetsAt ? new Date(u.resetsAt).toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }) : '';
        $('usageGauge').innerHTML =
          '<div class="usage-wrap"><div class="usage-head"><b>Cloudflare usage (app requests today)</b><span>' +
          (u.apiRequestsToday || 0).toLocaleString() + ' / ' + (u.limit || 100000).toLocaleString() + '</span></div>' +
          '<div class="usage-track"><div class="usage-fill ' + cls + '" style="width:' + pct + '%"></div></div>' +
          '<div class="admin-muted" style="margin-top:6px;">' +
          (pct >= 100
            ? '<b style="color:#fca5a5;">Limit reached — the site may stop working until it resets.</b> '
            : (pct >= 80 ? '<b style="color:#fde68a;">Getting close to the free limit.</b> ' : '')) +
          'Resets ' + escapeHtml(resetTxt) + ' (UTC midnight). Counts app/API calls only — game & image loads aren\'t included, so the real Cloudflare number is higher; check the Cloudflare dashboard for the exact total.</div></div>';

        $('anNowMetrics').innerHTML = metricCards([
          ['Online now', d.onlineNow || 0, 'on the tab right now'],
          ['Playing a game', d.playingNow || 0, 'on a game'],
          ['On site, no game', d.onSiteNotGame || 0, 'on a page'],
          ['Idle / other tab', d.otherTabNow || 0, 'switched away'],
          ['Offline (known)', d.offlineCount || 0, 'played before, not on now'],
          ['Tabs loaded', d.activeTabs || 0, 'incl. background'],
          ['Most at once', d.peakConcurrent || 0, d.peakAt ? new Date(d.peakAt).toLocaleString([], { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }) : 'all-time'],
        ]);

        const sc = d.stateCounts || {};
        const order = ['playing', 'game-idle', 'browsing', 'page-idle', 'game-bg', 'other-tab'];
        $('anStateBars').innerHTML = barsHtml(order.map(function(k) { return { label: STATE_ROW_LABELS[k] || k, value: sc[k] || 0 }; })) +
          '<div class="admin-muted" style="margin-top:4px;">A closed tab or asleep computer sends nothing, so it just drops off the list — it can\'t be counted.</div>';

        const gn = d.gamesNow || [];
        $('anGamesNow').innerHTML = gn.length
          ? gn.map(function(g) { return '<div class="admin-list-row"><span>🎮 ' + escapeHtml(g.game) + '</span><span>' + g.count + ' player' + (g.count === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</span></div>'; }).join('')
          : '<div class="admin-muted">No games being played right now.</div>';

        $('anVisitorMetrics').innerHTML = metricCards([
          ['Today', d.visitorsToday || 0, (d.newToday || 0) + ' first-time'],
          ['This week', d.visitorsWeek || 0, 'last 7 days'],
          ['This month', d.visitorsMonth || 0, 'last 30 days'],
          ['All-time', d.uniqueVisitorsAllTime || 0, (d.totalVisitsAllTime || 0) + ' visits'],
        ]);
        $('anTopToday').innerHTML = gamesList(d.topGamesToday);
        $('anTopWeek').innerHTML = gamesList(d.topGamesWeek);
        $('anTopMonth').innerHTML = gamesList(d.topGamesMonth);
        if ($('anUpdatedAt')) $('anUpdatedAt').textContent = 'Updated ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
      }

      // ----- the Live visitors list (search + filters + stable in-place refresh + grid) -----
      const VISITOR_FILTERS = [
        ['all', 'All'], ['playing', '🎮 Playing'], ['onsite', '📄 On site'],
        ['othertab', '🔀 Other tab'], ['idle', '💤 Idle'], ['offline', '⚫ Offline'],
        ['vip', '⭐ VIP'], ['hacks', '🎮 Hacks'], ['blocked', '🚫 Moderated'],
      ];
      let visitorFilter = lsGet('adminVisitorFilter') || 'all';
      window.setVisitorFilter = function(f) { visitorFilter = f; lsSet('adminVisitorFilter', f); renderVisitors(); };
      window.setVisitorCols = function(n) { lsSet('adminVisitorCols', String(n)); applyVisitorCols(); };
      function applyVisitorCols() {
        const n = lsGet('adminVisitorCols') || '1';
        const list = $('adminVisitorsList');
        if (list) list.className = 'admin-list admin-visitors-grid cols-' + (['1', '2', '3', '4'].indexOf(n) >= 0 ? n : '1');
        const sel = $('visitorCols'); if (sel) sel.value = n;
      }
      function renderVisitorFilters() {
        const el = $('visitorFilters'); if (!el) return;
        el.innerHTML = VISITOR_FILTERS.map(function(f) {
          return '<button class="admin-vfilter' + (visitorFilter === f[0] ? ' active' : '') + '" onclick="setVisitorFilter(\'' + f[0] + '\')">' + f[1] + '</button>';
        }).join('');
      }
      function matchesFilter(s) {
        switch (visitorFilter) {
          case 'playing': return s.state !== 'offline' && s.kind === 'game' && s.onTab;
          case 'onsite': return s.state !== 'offline' && s.kind !== 'game' && s.onTab;
          case 'othertab': return s.state !== 'offline' && !s.onTab;
          case 'idle': return s.state === 'page-idle' || s.state === 'game-idle';
          case 'offline': return s.state === 'offline';
          case 'vip': return s.role === 'vip';
          case 'hacks': return s.perks && s.perks.hacks;
          case 'blocked': return s.mod && s.mod !== 'none';
          default: return true;
        }
      }
      function matchesSearch(s, q) {
        if (!q) return true;
        const hay = [s.username, s.nickname, s.visitorId, s.page, (s.meta || {}).ip, s.role, s.state].join(' ').toLowerCase();
        return hay.indexOf(q) >= 0;
      }

      let _gameOpts = '';
      function gameOptions() {
        if (_gameOpts) return _gameOpts;
        try { if (typeof games !== 'undefined') _gameOpts = games.map(function(g) { return '<option value="' + escapeHtml(g.folder) + '">' + escapeHtml(g.title) + '</option>'; }).join(''); } catch (e) {}
        return _gameOpts;
      }
      function buildCard(s, now) {
        const where = s.kind === 'game' ? (s.page || 'a game') : (PAGE_NAMES[s.page] || s.page || 'Home');
        const stateLabel = STATE_LABELS[s.state] || (s.kind === 'game' ? '🎮 Playing' : '📄 On the site');
        const what = stateLabel + ' · ' + escapeHtml(where);
        const vid = escapeHtml(s.visitorId);
        const sid = escapeHtml(s.sid || '');
        const m = s.meta || {};
        const ua = parseUA(m.ua);
        const modBadge = s.mod && s.mod !== 'none' ? '<span class="admin-tag" style="background:rgba(185,28,28,0.35);color:#fecaca;">' + escapeHtml(MOD_LABELS[s.mod] || s.mod) + '</span>' : '';
        const roleBadge = s.role && s.role !== 'none' ? '<span class="admin-tag" style="background:rgba(180,140,20,0.35);color:#fde68a;">' + escapeHtml(ROLE_LABELS[s.role] || s.role) + '</span>' : '';
        const nickBadge = s.nickname ? '<span class="admin-tag" style="background:rgba(20,184,166,0.3);color:#99f6e4;" title="your private nickname">📝 ' + escapeHtml(s.nickname) + '</span>' : '';
        const perks = s.perks || {};
