        const perkBadges = (perks.early ? '<span class="admin-tag" style="background:rgba(59,130,246,0.3);color:#bfdbfe;">⚡ early</span>' : '') + (perks.hacks ? '<span class="admin-tag" style="background:rgba(147,51,234,0.3);color:#e9d5ff;">🎮 hacks</span>' : '');
        const usedBadges = (s.usedHacks ? '<span class="admin-tag" style="background:rgba(147,51,234,0.5);color:#fff;" title="used game hacks">🎮 used' + (now - s.usedHacks < 600000 ? ' ●' : '') + '</span>' : '') + (s.usedEarly ? '<span class="admin-tag" style="background:rgba(59,130,246,0.5);color:#fff;" title="used early access">⚡ used' + (now - s.usedEarly < 600000 ? ' ●' : '') + '</span>' : '');
        const locParts = [m.city, m.region, m.country].filter(Boolean).map(escapeHtml);
        const loc = (locParts.length ? locParts.join(', ') : 'Unknown') + ' ' + flagOf(m.country);
        function row(label, valueHtml, copyVal) {
          if (valueHtml == null || valueHtml === '') return '';
          const copy = copyVal ? ' <button class="admin-copy" data-copy="' + escapeHtml(copyVal) + '" title="Copy">⧉</button>' : '';
          return '<div class="admin-detail"><span class="admin-detail-k">' + label + '</span><span class="admin-detail-v">' + valueHtml + copy + '</span></div>';
        }
        const connMins = fmtDuration(now - s.firstSeen);
        const returning = (s.firstEver && (now - s.firstEver) > 6 * 3600000);
        const nameChanged = s.usernameAt ? ' · <span class="admin-muted" title="changed their username">✎ ' + fmtDuration(now - s.usernameAt) + ' ago</span>' : '';
        const details =
          row('Player ID', '<code>' + escapeHtml(String(s.visitorId).slice(0, 14)) + '…</code>', s.visitorId) +
          row('Username', escapeHtml(s.username) + nameChanged) +
          row('IP address', m.ip ? '<code>' + escapeHtml(m.ip) + '</code>' : '<span class="admin-muted">hidden (local)</span>', m.ip) +
          row('Location', loc) +
          (m.postal ? row('Postal', escapeHtml(m.postal)) : '') +
          row('ISP / network', m.org ? escapeHtml(m.org) + (m.asn ? ' <span class="admin-muted">(AS' + escapeHtml(m.asn) + ')</span>' : '') : '') +
          row('Device', escapeHtml(ua.device + ' · ' + ua.os)) +
          row('Browser', escapeHtml(ua.browser)) +
          row('Screen', s.screen ? escapeHtml(s.screen) : '') +
          row('Language', m.lang ? escapeHtml(m.lang.split(',')[0]) : '') +
          row('Their time zone', escapeHtml(s.tz || m.tz || '')) +
          row('Came from', m.ref ? escapeHtml(m.ref) : '<span class="admin-muted">direct / typed in</span>') +
          row('Connection', escapeHtml([m.proto, m.tls, m.colo ? 'via ' + m.colo : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))) +
          row('Connected', connMins + ' ago' + (returning ? ' · <span class="admin-tag">returning</span>' : ' · <span class="admin-tag">new</span>')) +
          row('Recent games', (s.activity && s.activity.length) ? s.activity.slice(0, 8).map(function(a) { return escapeHtml(a.g); }).join(', ') : '<span class="admin-muted">none yet</span>') +
          row('User agent', '<span class="admin-ua">' + escapeHtml(m.ua || 'unknown') + '</span>', m.ua);

        if (s.isAdmin) {
          return '<div class="admin-person" data-vid="' + vid + '"><div class="admin-person-top"><span class="admin-person-name">' +
            escapeHtml(s.username) + '<span class="admin-tag">you</span></span><span class="admin-muted">' + connMins + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="admin-person-what">' + what + '</div>' +
            '<details class="admin-person-details"><summary>Connection info</summary><div class="admin-detail-grid">' + details + '</div></details></div>';
        }

        // offline: played before but not detected right now — no live view, but you can still tag/moderate them for next time
        if (s.state === 'offline') {
          const lastSeenTxt = s.lastSeen ? (fmtDuration(now - s.lastSeen) + ' ago') : 'a while ago';
          const offDetails =
            row('Player ID', '<code>' + escapeHtml(String(s.visitorId).slice(0, 14)) + '…</code>', s.visitorId) +
            row('Username', escapeHtml(s.username)) +
            row('Last seen', escapeHtml(lastSeenTxt));
          return '' +
            '<div class="admin-person admin-offline" data-vid="' + vid + '" style="opacity:.75;">' +
              '<div class="admin-person-top">' +
                '<span class="admin-person-name">' + escapeHtml(s.username) + nickBadge + roleBadge + perkBadges + usedBadges + modBadge + '</span>' +
                '<span class="admin-muted">⚫ offline</span>' +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="admin-person-what">⚫ Offline · last seen ' + escapeHtml(lastSeenTxt) + '</div>' +
              '<details class="admin-person-details"><summary>Info</summary><div class="admin-detail-grid">' + offDetails + '</div></details>' +
              '<div class="admin-person-rename">' +
                '<input type="text" class="admin-nick-input" value="' + escapeHtml(s.nickname || '') + '" maxlength="40" placeholder="Private nickname (only you)" />' +
                '<button class="ghost" data-mod="nickname">Save</button>' +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="admin-person-actions">' +
                ((s.mod === 'block' || s.mod === 'pause') ?
                  '<button data-mod="mode" data-mode="none">▶ Turn their screen back on</button>'
                  : '<button class="danger" data-mod="mode" data-mode="block">🔒 Shut their screen (takes effect next time on)</button>') +
                (s.mod === 'nogames' ? '<button data-mod="mode" data-mode="none">🎮 Allow games</button>' : '<button data-mod="mode" data-mode="nogames">🚷 Block games only</button>') +
                (s.mod && s.mod !== 'none' ? '<button class="ghost" data-mod="clear">Clear all</button>' : '') +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="admin-person-dm">' +
                '<input type="text" class="admin-dm-input" placeholder="💬 Message (they\'ll see it when back)…" maxlength="300" />' +
                '<button data-mod="dm">Send</button>' +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="admin-person-role">Tier: ' +
                '<select data-mod="role">' +
                  '<option value="none"' + (!s.role || s.role === 'none' ? ' selected' : '') + '>Normal</option>' +
                  '<option value="vip"' + (s.role === 'vip' ? ' selected' : '') + '>⭐ VIP (early access + priority)</option>' +
                  '<option value="viewer"' + (s.role === 'viewer' ? ' selected' : '') + '>👁 Viewer (read-only live view)</option>' +
                '</select>' +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="admin-person-perks">Give them: ' +
                '<label><input type="checkbox" data-perk="early"' + (perks.early ? ' checked' : '') + (s.role === 'vip' ? ' disabled' : '') + '> ⚡ Early access</label>' +
                '<label><input type="checkbox" data-perk="priority"' + (perks.priority ? ' checked' : '') + (s.role === 'vip' ? ' disabled' : '') + '> ⭐ Priority suggestions</label>' +
                '<label><input type="checkbox" data-perk="hacks"' + (perks.hacks ? ' checked' : '') + '> 🎮 Game hacks</label>' +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }
        return '' +
          '<div class="admin-person" data-vid="' + vid + '">' +
            '<div class="admin-person-top">' +
              '<span class="admin-person-name">' + escapeHtml(s.username) + nickBadge + roleBadge + perkBadges + usedBadges + modBadge + '</span>' +
              '<span class="admin-muted">' + escapeHtml(connMins) + ' on site</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="admin-person-what">' + what + ' · ' + escapeHtml(ua.device) + ' · ' + loc + '</div>' +
            '<div class="admin-snap-wrap"><img class="admin-snap" data-sid="' + sid + '" alt="" /><div class="admin-snap-age admin-muted">starting live view…</div></div>' +
            '<details class="admin-person-details"><summary>Connection info</summary><div class="admin-detail-grid">' + details + '</div></details>' +
            '<div class="admin-person-rename">' +
              '<input type="text" class="admin-nick-input" value="' + escapeHtml(s.nickname || '') + '" maxlength="40" placeholder="Private nickname (only you)" />' +
              '<button class="ghost" data-mod="nickname">Save</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="admin-shut-box">' +
              ((s.mod === 'block' || s.mod === 'pause') ?
                '<div class="admin-shut-live">🔒 Their screen is shut down' + (s.modMsg ? ' — “' + escapeHtml(s.modMsg) + '”' : '') + '</div>' +
                '<button data-mod="mode" data-mode="none">▶ Turn their screen back on</button>'
              :
                '<input type="text" class="admin-shut-input" maxlength="500" placeholder="Message they\'ll see (optional)…" />' +
                '<button class="danger" data-mod="shut">🔒 Shut their screen down</button>'
              ) +
              '<a class="admin-shut-more" data-mod="shutfull" title="timer, access code, variables">⚙ full options →</a>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="admin-person-actions">' +
              (s.mod === 'nogames' ? '<button data-mod="mode" data-mode="none">🎮 Allow games</button>' : '<button data-mod="mode" data-mode="nogames">🚷 Block games only</button>') +
              '<button data-mod="kick">👢 Send home</button>' +
              (s.mod && s.mod !== 'none' ? '<button class="ghost" data-mod="clear">Clear all</button>' : '') +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="admin-person-control">' +
              '<select class="admin-force-select"><option value="">🎯 Force into game…</option>' + gameOptions() + '</select>' +
              '<button data-mod="forcegame">Go</button>' +
              '<button data-mod="remotehack" data-speed="0">❄ Freeze game</button>' +
              '<button data-mod="remotehack" data-speed="1">▶ Normal</button>' +
              '<button class="danger" data-mod="shutperson">🔒 Shut their screen</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="admin-person-dm">' +
              '<input type="text" class="admin-dm-input" placeholder="💬 Announce to ' + escapeHtml(s.username) + '…" maxlength="300" />' +
              '<button data-mod="dm">Send</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="admin-person-role">Tier: ' +
              '<select data-mod="role">' +
                '<option value="none"' + (!s.role || s.role === 'none' ? ' selected' : '') + '>Normal</option>' +
                '<option value="vip"' + (s.role === 'vip' ? ' selected' : '') + '>⭐ VIP (early access + priority)</option>' +
                '<option value="viewer"' + (s.role === 'viewer' ? ' selected' : '') + '>👁 Viewer (read-only live view)</option>' +
              '</select>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="admin-person-perks">Give them: ' +
              '<label><input type="checkbox" data-perk="early"' + (perks.early ? ' checked' : '') + (s.role === 'vip' ? ' disabled title="VIP already has this"' : '') + '> ⚡ Early access</label>' +
              '<label><input type="checkbox" data-perk="priority"' + (perks.priority ? ' checked' : '') + (s.role === 'vip' ? ' disabled title="VIP already has this"' : '') + '> ⭐ Priority suggestions</label>' +
              '<label><input type="checkbox" data-perk="hacks"' + (perks.hacks ? ' checked' : '') + '> 🎮 Game hacks</label>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>';
      }

      window.renderVisitors = function() {
        const list = $('adminVisitorsList'); if (!list) return;
        renderVisitorFilters();
        applyVisitorCols();
        const d = lastAnalytics || {};
        const now = d.serverNow || Date.now();
        const q = (($('visitorSearch') || {}).value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        // stable order: live first (by join order), offline last (most-recent first), so cards never shuffle
        const sessions = (d.activeSessions || []).slice().sort(function(a, b) {
          const ao = a.state === 'offline' ? 1 : 0, bo = b.state === 'offline' ? 1 : 0;
          if (ao !== bo) return ao - bo;
          if (ao) return (b.lastSeen || 0) - (a.lastSeen || 0); // offline: recent first
          return (a.firstSeen || 0) - (b.firstSeen || 0);        // live: stable join order
        });
        const shown = sessions.filter(function(s) { return matchesFilter(s) && matchesSearch(s, q); });
        $('visitorCountLabel').textContent = shown.length + ' of ' + sessions.length + ' shown';

        // preserve what the admin is interacting with, so a refresh doesn't move things away
        const openVids = []; list.querySelectorAll('.admin-person-details[open]').forEach(function(x) { const c = x.closest('.admin-person'); if (c) openVids.push(c.getAttribute('data-vid')); });
        const ae = document.activeElement;
        let focus = null;
        if (ae && list.contains(ae)) {
          const card = ae.closest('.admin-person');
          focus = { vid: card && card.getAttribute('data-vid'), cls: ae.className, val: ae.value, start: ae.selectionStart, end: ae.selectionEnd };
        }
        const scrollTop = list.scrollTop;

        list.innerHTML = shown.length ? shown.map(function(s) { return buildCard(s, now); }).join('')
          : '<div class="admin-muted">' + (sessions.length ? 'No one matches that filter/search.' : 'Nobody else is on right now.') + '</div>';

        // restore
        openVids.forEach(function(v) { const c = list.querySelector('.admin-person[data-vid="' + (window.CSS && CSS.escape ? CSS.escape(v) : v) + '"]'); if (c) { const dt = c.querySelector('.admin-person-details'); if (dt) dt.open = true; } });
        if (focus && focus.vid) {
          const c = list.querySelector('.admin-person[data-vid="' + (window.CSS && CSS.escape ? CSS.escape(focus.vid) : focus.vid) + '"]');
          const inp = c && focus.cls && c.querySelector('.' + focus.cls.split(' ')[0]);
          if (inp) { if (inp.classList.contains('admin-dm-input') || inp.classList.contains('admin-nick-input') || inp.classList.contains('admin-shut-input')) inp.value = focus.val; inp.focus(); try { inp.setSelectionRange(focus.start, focus.end); } catch (e) {} }
        }
        list.scrollTop = scrollTop;
        fetchSnapshots();
      };

      window.loadAnalytics = async function() {
        if (!isLoggedIn()) return;
        try {
          const res = await fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/analytics', { headers: adminHeaders(), cache: 'no-store' });
          if (res.status === 401) {
            clearAdminSecret();
            refreshPanelContent();
            $('adminLoginMsg').textContent = 'Your saved password stopped working — log in again.';
            return;
          }
          if (!res.ok) { $('adminUpdatedAt').textContent = 'Failed to load (' + res.status + ')'; return; }
          const d = await res.json();
          lastAnalytics = d;
          renderAnalytics(d);
          if (d.shutdown) setAdminShutdown(d.shutdown);
          fetchSnapshots(); // refill the live pictures right after re-rendering the cards
        } catch (e) {
          $('adminUpdatedAt').textContent = 'Network error';
        }
      };
      setInterval(function() {
        if (!panelVisible() || document.hidden) return;
        // don't yank a rename box or an open dropdown out from under you mid-interaction
        const ae = document.activeElement;
        if (ae && (ae.classList && (ae.classList.contains('admin-nick-input') || ae.classList.contains('admin-dm-input') || ae.classList.contains('admin-shut-input') || ae.id === 'visitorSearch') || ae.tagName === 'SELECT')) return;
        loadAnalytics();
      }, 20000);

      // Live-view pictures: pull the latest snapshots and drop them into each card, a few times a second's worth
      function onVisitorsTab() {
        const b = document.querySelector('.admin-tab-btn[data-admintab="visitors"]');
        return !!(b && b.classList.contains('active'));
      }
      window.fetchSnapshots = async function() {
        if (!isLoggedIn() || !panelVisible() || document.hidden || !onVisitorsTab()) return;
        if (!document.querySelector('img.admin-snap')) return;
        try {
          const r = await fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/snapshots', { headers: adminHeaders(), cache: 'no-store' });
          if (!r.ok) return;
          const d = await r.json();
          const snaps = d.snaps || {}, now = d.serverNow || Date.now();
          document.querySelectorAll('img.admin-snap').forEach(function(img) {
            const sid = img.getAttribute('data-sid');
            const s = sid && snaps[sid];
            const age = img.parentElement.querySelector('.admin-snap-age');
            if (s && s.img) {
              if (img.getAttribute('data-at') !== String(s.at)) { img.src = s.img; img.setAttribute('data-at', String(s.at)); }
              img.style.display = 'block';
              if (age) age.textContent = Math.max(0, Math.round((now - s.at) / 1000)) + 's ago';
            } else if (age) {
              age.textContent = 'waiting for a picture…';
            }
          });
        } catch (e) {}
      };
      setInterval(function() { fetchSnapshots(); }, 4000);

      window.resetAdminStats = async function() {
        if (!confirm('Reset ALL visitor stats (today, history, all-time, peak)? This cannot be undone.')) return;
        const r = await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/reset-stats');
        if (r.ok) loadAnalytics();
      };

      // ❤️ donations goal (admin-updated monthly)
      async function loadDonateAdmin() {
        try {
          const res = await fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/donate', { cache: 'no-store' });
          if (!res.ok) return;
          const d = await res.json();
          const ri = $('donateRaisedInput'), gi = $('donateGoalInput');
          if (ri) ri.value = (Number(d.raised) || 0);
          if (gi) gi.value = (Number(d.goal) || 7);
          const msg = $('donateAdminMsg'); if (msg) msg.textContent = 'Showing ' + (d.month || 'this month') + ': $' + (Number(d.raised)||0) + ' of $' + (Number(d.goal)||7) + ' (' + (d.pct||0) + '%).';
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      window.saveDonate = async function() {
        const ri = $('donateRaisedInput'), gi = $('donateGoalInput'), msg = $('donateAdminMsg');
        const raised = parseFloat(ri && ri.value), goal = parseFloat(gi && gi.value);
        const body = {};
        if (isFinite(raised) && raised >= 0) body.raised = raised;
        if (isFinite(goal) && goal > 0) body.goal = goal;
        if (msg) msg.textContent = 'Saving…';
        const r = await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/donate', body);
        if (r.ok && r.data && r.data.donate) {
          const d = r.data.donate;
          if (msg) msg.textContent = 'Saved — $' + d.raised + ' of $' + d.goal + ' (' + d.pct + '%). The Donate tab bar updates live.';
          if (window.refreshDonateGoal) window.refreshDonateGoal();
        } else if (msg) { msg.textContent = 'Failed to save (' + (r.status || '?') + ').'; }
      };

      // 📢 broadcast to everyone (persistent banner, timed or until turned off)
      window.sendBroadcast = async function() {
        const text = ($('broadcastMessage').value || '').trim();
        const st = $('broadcastStatus');
        if (!text) { st.textContent = 'Type a message first.'; return; }
        const timed = (document.querySelector('input[name="announceDuration"]:checked') || {}).value !== 'indefinite';
        let mins = null;
        if (timed) {
          const n = parseFloat($('announceAmount').value);
          if (!(n > 0)) { st.textContent = 'Enter how long (a number above 0).'; return; }
          mins = $('announceUnit').value === 'hours' ? n * 60 : n;
        }
        const target = getTarget('ann');
        if ((target.type === 'game' || target.type === 'person') && !target.value) { st.textContent = 'Pick a ' + (target.type === 'game' ? 'game' : 'person') + ' first.'; return; }
        st.textContent = 'Sending…';
        let r;
        if (target.type === 'all') r = await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/broadcast', { text: text, durationMinutes: mins });
        else r = await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/rule', { kind: 'ann', text: text, target: target, durationMinutes: mins });
        st.textContent = r.ok ? 'Live now — the selected people see it within ~20s.' : 'Failed (' + r.status + ').';
        loadRules(); pollNow();
      };
      window.clearBroadcast = async function() {
        const st = $('broadcastStatus');
        const r = await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/broadcast', { text: '' });
        if (r.ok) { st.textContent = 'Turned off.'; pollNow(); }
      };
      function renderBroadcastAdmin() {
        const bar = $('broadcastStatusBar'); if (!bar) return;
        const b = siteStatus && siteStatus.broadcast;
        if (b) {
          let s = '<span class="admin-status-pill on">📢 Announcement live</span> <span class="admin-muted">';
          if (b.endTime) { const left = b.endTime - (Date.now() + siteOffset); s += (left > 0 ? formatTimeLeft(left) + ' left' : 'ending…'); }
          else s += 'until you turn it off';
          s += '</span>';
          bar.innerHTML = s;
          if (!$('broadcastMessage').value) $('broadcastMessage').value = b.text;
        } else {
          bar.innerHTML = '<span class="admin-status-pill" style="background:rgba(148,163,184,0.25);color:#cbd5e1;">No announcement running</span>';
        }
      }

      // Per-person controls in the Live tab (pause / block / no games / kick / message / rename)
      async function adminModerate(body) { return adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/moderate', body); }
      $('adminVisitorsList').addEventListener('click', async function(e) {
        const copyBtn = e.target.closest('button.admin-copy');
        if (copyBtn) { e.preventDefault(); copyToClip(copyBtn.getAttribute('data-copy') || ''); return; }
        const btn = e.target.closest('button[data-mod]'); if (!btn) return;
        const row = e.target.closest('.admin-person'); if (!row) return;
        const vid = row.getAttribute('data-vid'); if (!vid) return;
        const kind = btn.getAttribute('data-mod');
        let body = null, text = null;
        if (kind === 'nickname') {
          const nick = (row.querySelector('.admin-nick-input').value || '').trim(); // empty clears it
          body = { visitorId: vid, action: 'nickname', nickname: nick };
          showToast(nick ? 'Nickname saved (only you see it)' : 'Nickname cleared');
        } else if (kind === 'mode') {
          body = { visitorId: vid, action: 'mode', mode: btn.getAttribute('data-mode') };
        } else if (kind === 'kick') {
          body = { visitorId: vid, action: 'kick' };
        } else if (kind === 'clear') {
          body = { visitorId: vid, action: 'clear' };
        } else if (kind === 'dm') {
          const inp = row.querySelector('.admin-dm-input');
          text = inp ? (inp.value || '').trim() : '';
          if (!text) { if (inp) inp.focus(); return; }
          body = { visitorId: vid, action: 'alert', text: text };
          if (inp) inp.value = '';
          showToast('Sent to ' + (row.querySelector('.admin-person-name') ? row.querySelector('.admin-person-name').firstChild.textContent : 'them'));
        } else if (kind === 'alert') {
          text = window.prompt('Message to show this person:');
          if (!text || !text.trim()) return;
          body = { visitorId: vid, action: 'alert', text: text.trim() };
        } else if (kind === 'forcegame') {
          const sel = row.querySelector('.admin-force-select');
          const folder = sel ? sel.value : '';
          if (!folder) { if (sel) sel.focus(); return; }
          body = { visitorId: vid, action: 'forcegame', folder: folder };
          showToast('Opening ' + folder + ' on their screen…');
        } else if (kind === 'remotehack') {
          const sp = parseFloat(btn.getAttribute('data-speed'));
          body = { visitorId: vid, action: 'remotehack', speed: sp };
          showToast(sp === 0 ? 'Freezing their game…' : 'Back to normal speed.');
        } else if (kind === 'shut') {
          const inp = row.querySelector('.admin-shut-input');
          const msg = inp ? (inp.value || '').trim() : '';
          body = { visitorId: vid, action: 'mode', mode: 'block', message: msg };
          showToast('Shut down their screen' + (msg ? ' with your message' : ''));
        } else if (kind === 'shutfull') {
          setShutWho('person', vid);
          showAdminTab('shutdown');
          return;
        } else if (kind === 'shutperson') {
          // jump to the Shutdown tab with this person pre-targeted (full customization there)
          setShutWho('person', vid);
          showAdminTab('shutdown');
          return;
        }
        if (!body) return;
        btn.disabled = true;
        try { await adminModerate(body); } catch (err) {}
        btn.disabled = false;
        loadAnalytics();
      });

      // tier dropdown (Normal / VIP / Viewer) + perk checkboxes
      $('adminVisitorsList').addEventListener('change', async function(e) {
        const row = e.target.closest('.admin-person'); if (!row) return;
        const vid = row.getAttribute('data-vid'); if (!vid) return;
        const sel = e.target.closest('select[data-mod="role"]');
        const perkBox = e.target.closest('input[data-perk]');
        if (sel) {
          sel.disabled = true;
          try { await adminModerate({ visitorId: vid, action: 'role', role: sel.value }); showToast('Tier updated'); } catch (err) {}
          sel.disabled = false;
          loadAnalytics();
        } else if (perkBox) {
          perkBox.disabled = true;
          try { await adminModerate({ visitorId: vid, action: 'perk', perk: perkBox.getAttribute('data-perk'), on: perkBox.checked }); showToast('Updated'); } catch (err) {}
          perkBox.disabled = false;
          loadAnalytics();
        }
      });

      // ---------- shutdown controls (admin side) ----------
      let adminShutdownState = null, adminShutdownOffset = 0;

      function setAdminShutdown(s) {
        adminShutdownState = s;
        adminShutdownOffset = (s.serverNow || Date.now()) - Date.now();
        // prefill the form from the live shutdown if you haven't typed anything
        if (s.active) {
          if (!$('shutdownMessage').value && s.message) $('shutdownMessage').value = s.message;
          if (!$('shutdownReason').value && s.reason) $('shutdownReason').value = s.reason;
          if (!$('shutdownCode').value && s.code) $('shutdownCode').value = s.code;
        }
        renderShutdownAdmin();
      }

      function formDurationMinutes() {
        const timed = (document.querySelector('input[name="shutdownDuration"]:checked') || {}).value === 'timed';
        if (!timed) return null;
        const n = parseFloat($('shutdownAmount').value);
        if (!(n > 0)) return 0;
        return $('shutdownUnit').value === 'hours' ? n * 60 : n;
      }

      function updatePreview() {
        const el = $('adminPreview'); if (!el) return;
        const s = adminShutdownState;
        const nowMs = Date.now() + adminShutdownOffset;
        let endTime;
        if (s && s.active) endTime = s.endTime || null;
        else { const mins = formDurationMinutes(); endTime = mins ? nowMs + mins * 60000 : null; }
        el.textContent = renderTemplate($('shutdownMessage').value || 'The site is temporarily down.', {
          endTime: endTime, reason: $('shutdownReason').value.trim(),
          visitorCount: lastAnalytics ? lastAnalytics.activeNow : null,
        }, nowMs);
      }

      function renderShutdownAdmin() {
        const el = $('adminShutdownStatus'); if (!el) return;
        const s = adminShutdownState;
        const live = !!(s && s.active && (!s.endTime || s.endTime - (Date.now() + adminShutdownOffset) > 0));
        if (!live) {
          el.innerHTML = '<span class="admin-status-pill on">🟢 Site is ON</span>';
        } else {
          const left = s.endTime ? s.endTime - (Date.now() + adminShutdownOffset) : null;
          el.innerHTML = '<span class="admin-status-pill off">🔴 Site is OFF for visitors</span> <span class="admin-muted">' +
            (s.endTime ? escapeHtml(formatTimeLeft(left)) + ' left' : 'until you turn it back on') +
            (s.code ? ' · code: <b>' + escapeHtml(s.code) + '</b>' : '') + '</span>';
        }
        $('adminExtendBtns').style.display = (live && s.endTime) ? 'block' : 'none';
        $('shutdownGoBtn').textContent = live ? 'Update shutdown' : 'Shut down site';
        updatePreview();
      }

      // ---------- "who" targeting (shared by Shutdown + Announce) ----------
      function whoExtraHtml(type) {
        if (type === 'game') return 'Game: <select class="who-game" style="flex:1;"><option value="">pick a game…</option>' + gameOptions() + '</select>';
        if (type === 'person') return 'Player ID: <input type="text" class="who-person" placeholder="paste their ID" style="flex:1;" />';
        return '';
      }
      function onWhoChange(prefix) {
        const typeSel = $(prefix + 'WhoType'), extra = $(prefix + 'WhoExtra'); if (!typeSel || !extra) return;
        const t = typeSel.value, needs = (t === 'game' || t === 'person');
        extra.innerHTML = needs ? whoExtraHtml(t) : '';
        extra.style.display = needs ? 'flex' : 'none';
      }
      window.onShutWhoChange = function() { onWhoChange('shut'); };
      window.onAnnWhoChange = function() { onWhoChange('ann'); };
      window.setShutWho = function(type, value) {
        const sel = $('shutWhoType'); if (!sel) return;
        sel.value = type; onWhoChange('shut');
        if (type === 'person') { const inp = $('shutWhoExtra').querySelector('.who-person'); if (inp) inp.value = value; }
        if (type === 'game') { const g = $('shutWhoExtra').querySelector('.who-game'); if (g) g.value = value; }
      };
      function getTarget(prefix) {
        const t = ($(prefix + 'WhoType') || {}).value || 'all';
        if (t.indexOf('state:') === 0) return { type: 'state', value: t.slice(6) };
        if (t === 'game') { const g = $(prefix + 'WhoExtra').querySelector('.who-game'); return { type: 'game', value: g ? g.value : '' }; }
        if (t === 'person') { const inp = $(prefix + 'WhoExtra').querySelector('.who-person'); return { type: 'person', value: inp ? inp.value.trim() : '' }; }
        return { type: t, value: '' };
      }
      async function loadRules() {
        try {
          const res = await fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/rules', { headers: adminHeaders(), cache: 'no-store' });
          if (!res.ok) return;
          const d = await res.json();
          renderRuleList('shutRulesList', d.shut, 'shut', d.serverNow);
          renderRuleList('annRulesList', d.ann, 'ann', d.serverNow);
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      function renderRuleList(elId, rules, kind, now) {
        const el = $(elId); if (!el) return;
        if (!rules || !rules.length) { el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
        el.innerHTML = '<div class="admin-muted" style="margin:4px 0;">Active ' + (kind === 'shut' ? 'shutdowns' : 'announcements') + ':</div>' +
          rules.map(function(r) {
            const left = r.endTime ? (' · ' + formatTimeLeft(r.endTime - (now || Date.now())) + ' left') : '';
            return '<div class="admin-list-row"><span>' + escapeHtml(r.label) + left + ' — “' + escapeHtml((r.text || '').slice(0, 40)) + '”</span>' +
              '<button class="ghost" onclick="clearRuleById(\'' + kind + '\',\'' + r.id + '\')">Turn off</button></div>';
          }).join('');
      }
      window.clearRuleById = async function(kind, id) {
        await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/rule-clear', { kind: kind, id: id });
        loadRules(); pollNow();
      };

      window.activateShutdown = async function() {
        const statusEl = $('shutdownStatusMsg');
        const mins = formDurationMinutes();
        if (mins === 0) { statusEl.textContent = 'Enter how long (a number above 0).'; return; }
        const target = getTarget('shut');
        if ((target.type === 'game' || target.type === 'person') && !target.value) { statusEl.textContent = 'Pick a ' + (target.type === 'game' ? 'game' : 'person') + ' first.'; return; }
        const msg = $('shutdownMessage').value.trim() || 'The site is temporarily down.';
        const reason = $('shutdownReason').value.trim(), code = $('shutdownCode').value.trim();
        statusEl.textContent = 'Saving...';
        try {
          let r;
          if (target.type === 'all') {
            r = await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/toggle', { active: true, message: msg, reason: reason, code: code, durationMinutes: mins });
            if (r.ok && r.data) setAdminShutdown(r.data);
          } else {
            r = await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/rule', { kind: 'shut', target: target, message: msg, reason: reason, code: code, durationMinutes: mins });
          }
          if (r.ok) { statusEl.textContent = 'Done — shutting down ' + (target.type === 'all' ? 'everyone' : 'the selected people') + ' (within ~20s).'; loadRules(); pollNow(); }
          else statusEl.textContent = 'Failed (' + r.status + ').';
        } catch (e) { statusEl.textContent = 'Network error.'; }
      };

      window.deactivateShutdown = async function() {
        const statusEl = $('shutdownStatusMsg');
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Saving...';
        try {
          const r = await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/toggle', { active: false });
          if (r.ok && r.data) {
            setAdminShutdown(r.data);
            if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Site is back on.';
            pollNow();
          } else if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Failed (' + r.status + ').';
        } catch (e) { if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Network error.'; }
      };

      window.extendShutdown = async function(minutes) {
        const r = await adminPost('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/admin/extend', { minutes: minutes });
        if (r.ok && r.data) { setAdminShutdown(r.data); pollNow(); }
      };

      // variable chips + draft memory
      $('adminVarChips').innerHTML = TEMPLATE_VARS.map(function(v) {
        return '<span class="admin-var-chip" data-var="{' + v + '}">{' + v + '}</span>';
      }).join('');
      $('adminVarChips').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const chip = e.target.closest('.admin-var-chip'); if (!chip) return;
        const ta = $('shutdownMessage'), v = chip.dataset.var;
        const s = ta.selectionStart != null ? ta.selectionStart : ta.value.length;
        const en = ta.selectionEnd != null ? ta.selectionEnd : ta.value.length;
        ta.value = ta.value.slice(0, s) + v + ta.value.slice(en);
        ta.focus();
        ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = s + v.length;
        saveDraft();
      });
      function saveDraft() {
        lsSet('adminShutdownDraft', JSON.stringify({
          message: $('shutdownMessage').value, reason: $('shutdownReason').value, code: $('shutdownCode').value,
          amount: $('shutdownAmount').value, unit: $('shutdownUnit').value,
          timed: (document.querySelector('input[name="shutdownDuration"]:checked') || {}).value !== 'indefinite',
        }));
        updatePreview();
      }
      (function restoreDraft() {
        try {
          const d = JSON.parse(lsGet('adminShutdownDraft') || 'null');
          if (!d) return;

          $('shutdownReason').value = d.reason || '';
          $('shutdownCode').value = d.code || '';
          if (d.amount) $('shutdownAmount').value = d.amount;
          if (d.unit) $('shutdownUnit').value = d.unit;
          const r = document.querySelector('input[name="shutdownDuration"][value="' + (d.timed === false ? 'indefinite' : 'timed') + '"]');
          if (r) r.checked = true;
        } catch (e) {}
      })();
      ['shutdownMessage', 'shutdownReason', 'shutdownCode', 'shutdownAmount', 'shutdownUnit'].forEach(function(id) {
        $(id).addEventListener('input', saveDraft);
        $(id).addEventListener('change', saveDraft);
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('input[name="shutdownDuration"]').forEach(function(r) { r.addEventListener('change', saveDraft); });
      $('shutdownAmount').addEventListener('focus', function() {
        const r = document.querySelector('input[name="shutdownDuration"][value="timed"]'); if (r) { r.checked = true; saveDraft(); }
      });

      // ---------- per-game cheat / modded versions ----------
      // ANY game can have a swappable cheat version: drop a hacked.html into its folder.
      // List the folders you've added a client to here so they show up in the Cheats tab:
      const CHEAT_CLIENT_GAMES = ['Minecraft 1.8.8'];
      const hackedCache = {}; // folder -> true/false (does games/<folder>/hacked.html exist?)
      function cheatUrl(folder) { return r2Url('games/' + folder + '/hacked.html'); }
      function normalUrl(folder) { return r2Url('games/' + folder + '/index.html'); }
      function cheatEnabledFor(folder) { return lsGet('cheatGame:' + folder) === '1'; }
      function setCheatEnabledFor(folder, on) { lsSet('cheatGame:' + folder, on ? '1' : '0'); }
      function checkHackedFor(folder) {
        if (folder == null) return Promise.resolve(false);
        if (folder in hackedCache) return Promise.resolve(hackedCache[folder]);
        return fetch(cheatUrl(folder), { method: 'HEAD', cache: 'no-store' })
          .then(function(r) { hackedCache[folder] = r.ok; return r.ok; })
          .catch(function() { hackedCache[folder] = false; return false; });
      }
      // Admin "Cheats" tab: list of cheat-client games with on/off toggles
      function syncCheatsUI() {
        renderCheatClientList();

        if ($('cgSpeedVal')) $('cgSpeedVal').textContent = hackSpeed + 'x';
        if ($('cgZoom')) $('cgZoom').value = hackZoom;
        if ($('cgZoomVal')) $('cgZoomVal').textContent = hackZoom + 'x';
        if ($('cgAuto')) $('cgAuto').checked = hackAutoClick;
        if ($('cgMute')) $('cgMute').checked = hackMute;

        const st = $('cheatStatus');
        if (st) st.innerHTML = inGame()
          ? 'You\'re in <code>' + escapeHtml(currentGame.folder) + '</code>. Turning its cheat on takes effect next time it\'s opened (it won\'t reload mid-game).'
          : '<i>Open a game to play with its cheat client.</i>';
      }
      function renderCheatClientList() {
        const el = $('cheatClientList'); if (!el) return;
        if (!CHEAT_CLIENT_GAMES.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="admin-muted">No cheat clients added yet.</div>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = CHEAT_CLIENT_GAMES.map(function(folder) {
          const on = cheatEnabledFor(folder);
          return '<div class="admin-list-row"><span>⚡ ' + escapeHtml(folder) + '</span>' +
            '<label class="tog"><input type="checkbox" class="cheat-game-toggle" data-folder="' + escapeHtml(folder) + '"' + (on ? ' checked' : '') + '><span class="tog-sl"></span></label></div>';
        }).join('');
      }
      // toggling a cheat only sets the preference — it does NOT reload a running game.

      window.toggleCheatFromHacks = function(on) {

        setCheatEnabledFor(currentGame.folder, on);

        showToast(on ? 'Cheat on — loads next time you open this game.' : 'Cheat off — loads normal next time.');
      };
      // Cheats-tab per-game toggles (no reload; applies next time the game opens)
      (function() {
        const el = $('cheatClientList');
        if (el) el.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
          const t = e.target.closest('.cheat-game-toggle'); if (!t) return;
          setCheatEnabledFor(t.getAttribute('data-folder'), t.checked);

        });
      })();
      // show the ⚡ Cheat version toggle in the 🎮 menu when the current game has a cheat build
      function updateCheatRow() {
        const rowEl = $('hackCheatRow'); if (!rowEl) return;
        if (!(perkHacks && inGame())) { rowEl.style.display = 'none'; return; }
        const folder = currentGame.folder;
        checkHackedFor(folder).then(function(avail) {
          if (!inGame() || currentGame.folder !== folder) return;
          rowEl.style.display = avail ? 'block' : 'none';

          const tg = $('hackCheatToggle'); if (tg) tg.checked = cheatEnabledFor(folder);
        });
      }
      if (typeof window.openGame === 'function') {
        const origOpenGame = window.openGame;
        window.openGame = function(game) {
          // a visitor the admin put on "no games" can still browse, just not open games

          if (window.__feNoGames && !iAmAdmin) {
            showToast('Games are turned off for you right now.');
            return;
          }
          // a fresh game should start clean — drop any leftover speed/freeze from the last game
          resetHacksSilently();
          const r = origOpenGame.apply(this, arguments);
          try {

            if (game && game.folder && (iAmAdmin || perkHacks) && cheatEnabledFor(game.folder)) {

      }

      // ---------- every visitor: heartbeat + live shutdown status ----------
      let siteStatus = null, siteOffset = 0, pollTimer = null, polling = false, blockedShown = false, expiredHandled = false;
      let personalOverlayShown = false;
      let personalMode = 'none';
      let lastCloseId = parseInt(lsGet('modLastCloseId') || '0', 10) || 0;
      let lastAlertId = parseInt(lsGet('modLastAlertId') || '0', 10) || 0;
      let lastForceId = parseInt(lsGet('modLastForceId') || '0', 10) || 0;
      let lastHackId = parseInt(lsGet('modLastHackId') || '0', 10) || 0;
      window.__feNoGames = false;

      // What one specific visitor sees when the admin has singled them out.
      // (Only affects THIS website in their browser tab — nothing else on their device.)
      function applyPersonalMod() {
        const overlay = $('personalOverlay'); if (!overlay) return;
        const iAmAdmin = !!(siteStatus && siteStatus.isAdmin);
        const mod = (!iAmAdmin && siteStatus && siteStatus.me && siteStatus.me.mod) ? siteStatus.me.mod : null;
        const mode = mod ? (mod.mode || 'none') : 'none';
        personalMode = mode;
        window.__feNoGames = (mode === 'nogames');

        if (mode === 'block' || mode === 'pause') {
          if (mode === 'block') { try { if (typeof currentGame !== 'undefined' && currentGame && typeof closeGame === 'function') closeGame(); } catch (e) {} }
          $('personalOverlayIcon').textContent = mode === 'pause' ? '⏸️' : '🚫';
          $('personalOverlayText').textContent = (mod.message && mod.message.trim())
            ? mod.message
            : (mode === 'pause' ? 'Your screen has been paused by the site admin. Sit tight — it will come back.'
                               : 'The site has been turned off for you by the admin.');
          overlay.style.display = 'flex';
          personalOverlayShown = true;
        } else {
          overlay.style.display = 'none';
          personalOverlayShown = false;
        }

        if (mode === 'nogames') {
          try { if (typeof currentGame !== 'undefined' && currentGame && typeof closeGame === 'function') { closeGame(); showToast('Games are turned off for you right now.'); } } catch (e) {}
        }

        // one-time "kick out of the game" signal
        if (mod && mod.closeGameId && mod.closeGameId > lastCloseId) {
          lastCloseId = mod.closeGameId; lsSet('modLastCloseId', String(lastCloseId));
          try { if (typeof currentGame !== 'undefined' && currentGame && typeof closeGame === 'function') { closeGame(); showToast('The admin sent you back to the home page.'); } } catch (e) {}
        }
        // one-time popup message
        if (mod && mod.alert && mod.alert.id > lastAlertId) {
          lastAlertId = mod.alert.id; lsSet('modLastAlertId', String(lastAlertId));
          showToast('💬 ' + mod.alert.text, 9000);
        }
        // admin forces them into a specific game
        if (mod && mod.forceGame && mod.forceGame.id > lastForceId) {
          lastForceId = mod.forceGame.id; lsSet('modLastForceId', String(lastForceId));
          try {
            const g = (typeof games !== 'undefined') ? games.find(function(x) { return x.folder === mod.forceGame.folder; }) : null;
            if (g && typeof openGame === 'function') { openGame(g); showToast('The admin opened a game for you.'); }
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        // admin remotely sets their game's speed (0 = freeze)
        if (mod && mod.hack && mod.hack.id > lastHackId) {
          lastHackId = mod.hack.id; lsSet('modLastHackId', String(lastHackId));
          try { const f = $('gameFrame'); if (f && f.contentWindow) f.contentWindow.postMessage({ __feHack: { speed: mod.hack.speed } }, '*'); } catch (e) {}
        }

        document.body.style.overflow = (blockedShown || personalOverlayShown) ? 'hidden' : '';
      }

      function getVisitorId() { let v = lsGet('siteVisitorId'); if (!v) { v = uuid(); lsSet('siteVisitorId', v); } return v; }
      function getSessionId() { let s = ssGet('siteSessionId'); if (!s) { s = uuid(); ssSet('siteSessionId', s); } return s; }

      // track real activity so the admin can tell "actually playing" from "tab just left open"
      let lastInteract = Date.now();
      function markActive() { lastInteract = Date.now(); }
      ['pointerdown', 'mousemove', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll', 'wheel', 'click'].forEach(function(ev) {
        window.addEventListener(ev, markActive, { passive: true });
      });
      // a game runs in an iframe, so mouse/keys there don't reach the top page.
      // game-capture.js inside same-origin games reports real input as __feActive so we can still tell active from AFK.
      window.addEventListener('message', function(e) { if (e.data && e.data.__feActive) markActive(); });
      function currentActivity() {
        try { if (typeof currentGame !== 'undefined' && currentGame && currentGame.title) return { kind: 'game', page: currentGame.title }; } catch (e) {}
        if (adminTabActive) return { kind: 'browse', page: 'admin' };
        try { if (typeof currentFilter !== 'undefined') return { kind: 'browse', page: String(currentFilter) }; } catch (e) {}
        return { kind: 'browse', page: 'home' };
      }

      function scheduleNextPoll() {
        clearTimeout(pollTimer);
        pollTimer = setTimeout(pollNow, document.hidden ? 90000 : 20000);
      }

      async function pollNow() {
        if (polling) return;
        polling = true;
        try {
          const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
          const secret = getAdminSecret(); if (secret) headers['X-Admin-Secret'] = secret;
          const code = lsGet('shutdownBypassCode'); if (code) headers['X-Bypass-Code'] = code;
          const act = currentActivity();
          const res = await fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/poll', {
            method: 'POST', headers: headers, cache: 'no-store',
            body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId: getSessionId(), visitorId: getVisitorId(), page: act.page, kind: act.kind, tz: userTz(),
              screen: (window.screen ? (window.screen.width + 'x' + window.screen.height) : ''),
              visible: !document.hidden, focused: (document.hasFocus ? document.hasFocus() : true),
              idleMs: Date.now() - lastInteract, username: (lsGet('siteUsername') || '') }),
          });
          if (res.ok) {
            siteStatus = await res.json();
            siteOffset = (siteStatus.serverNow || Date.now()) - Date.now();
            expiredHandled = false;
            if (!siteStatus.active) lsDel('shutdownBypassCode');
            applySiteStatus();
          }
        } catch (e) { /* keep last known state if the check fails */ }
        finally { polling = false; scheduleNextPoll(); }
      }
      window.adminPollNow = pollNow;

      function effectiveActive() {
        if (!siteStatus || !siteStatus.active) return false;
        if (siteStatus.endTime && siteStatus.endTime - (Date.now() + siteOffset) <= 0) return false;
        return true;
      }

      function applySiteStatus() {
        const overlay = $('shutdownOverlay'), banner = $('adminShutdownBanner');
        const active = effectiveActive();
        const isAdmin = !!(siteStatus && siteStatus.isAdmin);
        const exempt = isAdmin || !!(siteStatus && siteStatus.bypass);
        const block = active && !exempt;

        if (block) {
          if (!blockedShown) {
            blockedShown = true;
            try { if (typeof currentGame !== 'undefined' && currentGame && typeof closeGame === 'function') closeGame(); } catch (e) {}
          }
          overlay.style.display = 'flex';
          $('shutdownCodeBox').style.display = siteStatus.hasCode ? 'block' : 'none';
        } else {
          overlay.style.display = 'none';
          blockedShown = false;
        }
        banner.style.display = (active && isAdmin) ? 'flex' : 'none';
        applyPersonalMod(); // also sets the body scroll lock for both overlays
        updateMonitoring(); // start/stop sending live-view pictures
        applyRole();        // VIP welcome / Viewer read-only panel
        applyBroadcast();   // show an announcement to everyone, once
        tick();
      }

      // 📢 announcement banner (persistent, like the shutdown; each visitor can dismiss with ✕)
      let announceDismissedId = parseInt(lsGet('announceDismissed') || '0', 10) || 0;
      window.dismissAnnounce = function() {
        const b = siteStatus && siteStatus.broadcast;
        if (b) { announceDismissedId = b.id; lsSet('announceDismissed', String(b.id)); }
        const el = $('announceBanner'); if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
      };
      function applyBroadcast() {
        const el = $('announceBanner'); if (!el) return;
        const b = siteStatus && siteStatus.broadcast;
        const iAmAdmin = !!(siteStatus && siteStatus.isAdmin);
        // show to everyone (incl. admin so you can see your own live), unless this visitor dismissed THIS one
        if (!b || b.id === announceDismissedId) { el.style.display = 'none'; return; }
        renderAnnounceBanner();
        el.style.display = 'block';
      }
      function renderAnnounceBanner() {
        const b = siteStatus && siteStatus.broadcast;
        const txt = $('announceBannerText'); if (!b || !txt) return;
        let s = '📢 ' + b.text;
        if (b.endTime) {
          const left = b.endTime - (Date.now() + siteOffset);
          if (left > 0) s += '  ·  ' + formatTimeLeft(left) + ' left';
        }
        txt.textContent = s;
      }

      // ---------- donations (Ko-fi + monthly $7 goal bar) ----------
      // ⬇⬇⬇ PUT YOUR KO-FI USERNAME HERE (the part after ko-fi.com/). e.g. "freeeducation" ⬇⬇⬇
      const KOFI_NAME = "buffoloremote";
      const KOFI_URL = /^[\w-]+$/.test(KOFI_NAME) && KOFI_NAME !== "YOUR_KOFI_NAME"
        ? ("https://ko-fi.com/" + KOFI_NAME)
        : "https://ko-fi.com/";
      (function initDonateButton() {
        const b = document.getElementById('donateBtn'); if (b) b.href = KOFI_URL;
      })();
      window.refreshDonateGoal = async function () {
        try {
          const res = await fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/donate', { cache: 'no-store' });
          if (!res.ok) return;
          const d = await res.json();
          const raised = Number(d.raised) || 0, goal = Number(d.goal) || 7;
          const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, d.pct != null ? d.pct : Math.round((raised / goal) * 100)));
          const fmt = function (n) { return '$' + (Math.round(n * 100) / 100).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); };
          const rEl = document.getElementById('donateRaised'); if (rEl) rEl.textContent = fmt(raised);
          const gEl = document.getElementById('donateGoal'); if (gEl) gEl.textContent = fmt(goal);
          const fEl = document.getElementById('donateBarFill'); if (fEl) fEl.style.width = pct + '%';
          const sub = document.getElementById('donateGoalSub');
          if (sub) {
            sub.textContent = raised >= goal
              ? '🎉 This month’s goal is covered — thank you so much! Extra helps the next month.'
              : (fmt(goal - raised) + ' to go this month (' + pct + '%). Every bit helps keep the proxy online.');
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      };

      // ---------- recurring tips (back up data / save a second link / donate) ----------
      function remindersOn() { return lsGet('feReminders') !== '0'; }
      const FE_REMINDERS = [
        '💾 Tip: back up your stuff — open ⚙️ Settings and tap Export Data so you never lose your progress.',
        '🔗 Tip: save a second link from the Links tab, so you can still get in if this one ever gets blocked.',
        'The Web Proxy costs ~$7/month to keep up and Im broke lol — if you can, the Donate tab helps keep it online. No pressure, the games stay free!'
      ];
      let reminderIx = parseInt(lsGet('reminderIx') || '0', 10) || 0;
      let reminderTimer = null;
      function scheduleReminder(ms) { clearTimeout(reminderTimer); reminderTimer = setTimeout(showNextReminder, ms); }
      function showNextReminder() {
        const canShow = remindersOn() && !document.hidden && !(siteStatus && siteStatus.isAdmin) && !blockedShown && !personalOverlayShown;
        if (canShow) {
          showToast(FE_REMINDERS[reminderIx % FE_REMINDERS.length], 9000);
          reminderIx++; lsSet('reminderIx', String(reminderIx));
          scheduleReminder(18 * 60000); // ~every 18 min after the first
        } else {
          scheduleReminder(3 * 60000);  // off/hidden right now — check again soon
        }
      }

      function tick() {
        const nowMs = Date.now() + siteOffset;
        if (siteStatus && siteStatus.active) {
          if (siteStatus.endTime && siteStatus.endTime - nowMs <= 0 && !expiredHandled) {
            // time's up: open the site right away, then confirm with the server
            expiredHandled = true;
            applySiteStatus();
            setTimeout(pollNow, 1500);
            return;
          }
          $('shutdownOverlayText').textContent = renderTemplate(siteStatus.message || 'The site is temporarily down.', siteStatus, nowMs);
          const left = siteStatus.endTime ? siteStatus.endTime - nowMs : null;
          $('adminShutdownBannerText').textContent = '🔒 Site is off for visitors' +
            (left != null ? ' — ' + formatTimeLeft(left) + ' left' : ' until you turn it back on') + ' (you can still use it)';
        }
        if (panelVisible()) { renderShutdownAdmin(); renderBroadcastAdmin(); }
        updateHacksButton(); // show/hide the hacks button as games open and close
        // live countdown / auto-hide for the announcement banner
        const ab = $('announceBanner');
        if (ab && ab.style.display === 'block') {
          const b = siteStatus && siteStatus.broadcast;
          if (b && b.endTime && b.endTime - (Date.now() + siteOffset) <= 0) ab.style.display = 'none';
          else renderAnnounceBanner();
        }
      }
      setInterval(tick, 1000);

      // ---------- live view: a picture of what this visitor is doing, sent only while the admin is watching ----------
      let snapTimer = null, h2cState = 0, h2cWaiters = []; // h2cState: 0 idle, 1 loading, 2 ready, 3 failed
      function ensureH2C(cb) {
        if (h2cState === 2) return cb(true);
        if (h2cState === 3) return cb(false);
        h2cWaiters.push(cb);
        if (h2cState === 1) return;
        h2cState = 1;
        const sc = document.createElement('script');
        sc.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js';
        sc.onload = function() { h2cState = window.html2canvas ? 2 : 3; h2cWaiters.splice(0).forEach(function(f) { f(h2cState === 2); }); };
        sc.onerror = function() { h2cState = 3; h2cWaiters.splice(0).forEach(function(f) { f(false); }); };
        document.head.appendChild(sc);
      }
      function downscaleToJpeg(srcCanvas, maxW) {
        try {
          const sw = srcCanvas.width, sh = srcCanvas.height;
          if (!sw || !sh) return null;
          const scale = Math.min(1, (maxW || 640) / sw);
          const c = document.createElement('canvas');
          c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(sw * scale)); c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(sh * scale));
          c.getContext('2d').drawImage(srcCanvas, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
          return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.72);
        } catch (e) { return null; }
      }
      // ask the (same-origin) game iframe for its actual canvas frame
      function grabFromGame(cb) {
        const frame = $('gameFrame');
        if (!frame || !frame.contentWindow) { cb(null); return; }
        const id = String(Date.now()) + Math.random();
        let done = false;
        function onMsg(e) { if (e.data && e.data.__feFrame === id) { done = true; window.removeEventListener('message', onMsg); cb(e.data.img || null); } }
        window.addEventListener('message', onMsg);
        try { frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ __feGrab: id, maxW: 640 }, '*'); } catch (e) {}
        setTimeout(function() { if (!done) { window.removeEventListener('message', onMsg); cb(null); } }, 1400);
      }
      // fallback picture when the game can't be read (cross-origin): the game's own thumbnail
      const _thumbShotCache = {};
      function gameThumbShot(folder, cb) {
        const src = r2Url('games/' + folder + '/thumb.png');
        if (_thumbShotCache[src] !== undefined) return cb(_thumbShotCache[src]);
        const im = new Image();
        im.onload = function() {
          try {
            const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 320; c.height = 180;
            const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); ctx.fillStyle = '#0b0f16'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180);
            const r = Math.min(320 / im.width, 180 / im.height), w = im.width * r, h = im.height * r;
            ctx.drawImage(im, (320 - w) / 2, (180 - h) / 2, w, h);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 152, 320, 28);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '13px system-ui, sans-serif'; ctx.fillText('▶ ' + folder, 8, 171);
            const out = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.6); _thumbShotCache[src] = out; cb(out);
          } catch (e) { _thumbShotCache[src] = null; cb(null); }
        };
        im.onerror = function() { _thumbShotCache[src] = null; cb(null); };
        im.src = src;
      }
      let _lastSnapKey = '', _lastSnapAt = 0;
      function sendSnapshot(img) {
        if (!img) return;
        // skip uploads when the screen hasn't really changed (saves a lot of requests on static screens),
        // but still send at least once every 30s so the admin knows it's live
        const key = img.length + ':' + img.slice(-48);
        const now = Date.now();
        if (key === _lastSnapKey && now - _lastSnapAt < 30000) return;
        _lastSnapKey = key; _lastSnapAt = now;
        fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/snapshot', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, cache: 'no-store',
          body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId: getSessionId(), visitorId: getVisitorId(), img: img }) }).catch(function() {});
      }
      function captureAndSend() {
        try {
          const inGame = (typeof currentGame !== 'undefined' && currentGame);
          if (inGame) {
            const folder = currentGame.folder;
            grabFromGame(function(img) {
              if (img) sendSnapshot(img);
              else gameThumbShot(folder, function(t) { if (t) sendSnapshot(t); });
            });
          } else {
            ensureH2C(function(ok) {
              if (!ok || !window.html2canvas) return;
              try {
                window.html2canvas(document.body, {
                  backgroundColor: '#0b0f16', logging: false, useCORS: true, imageTimeout: 1200,
                  width: window.innerWidth, height: window.innerHeight, x: window.scrollX, y: window.scrollY,
                  windowWidth: window.innerWidth, windowHeight: window.innerHeight,
                  ignoreElements: function(el) {
                    const id = el.id;
                    return id === 'adminPanel' || id === 'adminBackdrop' || id === 'adminMiniBtn' ||
                           id === 'adminShutdownBanner' || id === 'personalOverlay' || id === 'feToast' || id === 'shutdownOverlay';
                  }
                }).then(function(canvas) { const img = downscaleToJpeg(canvas, 640); if (img) sendSnapshot(img); }).catch(function() {});
              } catch (e) {}
            });
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      function updateMonitoring() {
        const iAmAdmin = !!(siteStatus && siteStatus.isAdmin);
        const watch = !!(siteStatus && siteStatus.watching) && !iAmAdmin && !document.hidden;
        if (watch) {
          if (!snapTimer) { captureAndSend(); snapTimer = setInterval(captureAndSend, 4000); }
        } else if (snapTimer) {
          clearInterval(snapTimer); snapTimer = null;
        }
      }

      // ---------- roles / tiers the admin can grant a visitor ----------
      let lastRoleSeen = parseInt(lsGet('roleSeenAt') || '0', 10) || 0;
      let viewerClosed = false;
      window.closeViewerPanel = function() { viewerClosed = true; const v = $('viewerPanel'); if (v) v.style.display = 'none'; };
      function renderViewerPanel(lv) {
        const body = $('viewerBody'); if (!body || !lv) return;
        let html = '<div class="vcounts">' +
          '<span class="vpill">🎮 ' + (lv.playing || 0) + ' playing</span>' +
          '<span class="vpill">📄 ' + (lv.browsing || 0) + ' browsing</span>' +
          '<span class="vpill">💤 ' + (lv.idle || 0) + ' idle</span></div>';
        html += (lv.people && lv.people.length)
          ? lv.people.map(function(p) {
              const label = STATE_LABELS[p.state] || p.state;
              const where = p.page ? ' · ' + escapeHtml(p.page) : '';
              return '<div class="vrow"><span>' + escapeHtml(p.username) + '</span><span>' + label + where + '</span></div>';
            }).join('')
          : '<div class="admin-muted">Nobody on right now.</div>';
        body.innerHTML = html;
      }
      let perkEarly = false, perkPriority = false, perkHacks = false;
      function applyRole() {
        const me = siteStatus && siteStatus.me;
        const iAmAdmin = !!(siteStatus && siteStatus.isAdmin);
        const role = me ? (me.role || 'none') : 'none';
        const roleAt = me ? (me.roleAt || 0) : 0;
        const perks = (me && me.perks) || {};
        const vp = $('viewerPanel');

        perkEarly = !!perks.early;
        perkPriority = !!perks.priority || role === 'vip';
        perkHacks = !!perks.hacks || iAmAdmin; // admin always has the in-game hacks menu

        // one-time welcome when a tier is first granted (not for the admin's own tab)
        if (!iAmAdmin && role !== 'none' && roleAt && roleAt > lastRoleSeen) {
          lastRoleSeen = roleAt; lsSet('roleSeenAt', String(roleAt));
          if (role === 'vip') showToast('⭐ You were made a VIP! You get early access + priority suggestions.', 9000);
          else if (role === 'viewer') showToast('👁 You were given the live viewer.', 9000);
        }

        // ⚡ Early access nav pill
        const earlyPill = $('earlyNavPill');
        if (earlyPill) earlyPill.style.display = perkEarly ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';

        // ⭐ priority suggestions: make the secret @ easy to find
        const at = $('priorityAt');
        if (at) { if (perkPriority) { at.style.opacity = '0.7'; at.title = 'Priority suggestions'; } else { at.style.opacity = ''; at.title = ''; } }

        // 🎮 game hacks button (shown while in a game)
        updateHacksButton();

        // 👁 Viewer read-only live panel (not for the admin's own tab)
        if (!iAmAdmin && role === 'viewer' && siteStatus.liveView) {
          renderViewerPanel(siteStatus.liveView);
          if (vp && !viewerClosed) vp.style.display = 'block';
        } else if (vp) {
          vp.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }

      // ---------- in-game hacks (speed / freeze / Minecraft client) ----------
      let hackSpeed = 1, hackPaused = false;
      function inGame() { try { return typeof currentGame !== 'undefined' && currentGame; } catch (e) { return false; } }
      function updateHacksButton() {
        const btn = $('hacksBtn'); const menu = $('hacksMenu');
        const iAmAdmin = !!(siteStatus && siteStatus.isAdmin);
        // the floating 🎮 menu is only for non-admin people with the hacks perk.
        // as the admin you use the Cheats tab instead (no floating menu over your games).
        const show = perkHacks && inGame() && !iAmAdmin;
        if (btn) btn.style.display = show ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (!show && menu) menu.style.display = 'none';
        if (show) updateCheatRow();
      }
      let hackZoom = 1, hackAutoClick = false, hackCps = 10, hackMute = false;
      // throttled "this person used a perk" ping so the admin can see who's using hacks/early access
      const _lastEvent = {};
      function logEvent(type) {
        const now = Date.now();
        if (_lastEvent[type] && now - _lastEvent[type] < 60000) return; // at most once/min per type
        _lastEvent[type] = now;
        try {
          fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/event', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, cache: 'no-store',
            body: JSON.stringify({ type: type, sessionId: getSessionId(), visitorId: getVisitorId() }) }).catch(function() {});
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      window.logEarlyUse = function() { logEvent('early'); };
      function sendHack(obj) {
        const f = $('gameFrame');
        if (f && f.contentWindow) { try { f.contentWindow.postMessage({ __feHack: obj }, '*'); } catch (e) {} }
        logEvent('hacks');
      }
      // sync a value to both the in-game menu control and the Cheats-tab control
      function setBoth(id1, id2, prop, val) { const a = $(id1), b = $(id2); if (a) a[prop] = val; if (b) b[prop] = val; }
      window.toggleHacksMenu = function() { const m = $('hacksMenu'); if (m) m.style.display = (m.style.display === 'block') ? 'none' : 'block'; };
      window.applyHackSpeed = function(v) { hackSpeed = parseFloat(v) || 1; setBoth('hackSpeedVal', 'cgSpeedVal', 'textContent', hackSpeed + 'x'); setBoth('hackSpeed', 'cgSpeed', 'value', hackSpeed); if (!hackPaused) sendHack({ speed: hackSpeed }); };
      window.toggleHackPause = function() { hackPaused = !hackPaused; setBoth('hackPauseBtn', 'cgPauseBtn', 'textContent', hackPaused ? '▶ Unfreeze' : '⏸ Freeze'); sendHack({ speed: hackPaused ? 0 : hackSpeed }); };
      window.applyHackZoom = function(v) { hackZoom = parseFloat(v) || 1; setBoth('hackZoomVal', 'cgZoomVal', 'textContent', hackZoom + 'x'); setBoth('hackZoom', 'cgZoom', 'value', hackZoom); sendHack({ zoom: hackZoom }); };
      window.toggleAutoClick = function(on) { hackAutoClick = !!on; setBoth('hackAutoClick', 'cgAuto', 'checked', hackAutoClick); sendHack({ autoclick: { on: hackAutoClick, cps: hackCps } }); };
      window.updateAutoClickRate = function(v) { hackCps = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, parseInt(v, 10) || 10)); setBoth('hackCps', 'cgCps', 'value', hackCps); if (hackAutoClick) sendHack({ autoclick: { on: true, cps: hackCps } }); };
      window.toggleHackMute = function(on) { hackMute = !!on; setBoth('hackMute', 'cgMute', 'checked', hackMute); sendHack({ mute: hackMute }); };
      window.hackScreenshot = function() {
        logEvent('hacks');
        grabFromGame(function(img) {
          if (!img) { showToast("Couldn't grab this game's screen."); return; }
          const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = img; a.download = (inGame() ? currentGame.folder : 'game') + '-screenshot.jpg'; a.click();
        });
      };
      window.resetHacks = function() {
        hackSpeed = 1; hackPaused = false; hackZoom = 1; hackAutoClick = false; hackMute = false;
        if ($('hackSpeed')) $('hackSpeed').value = 1; $('hackSpeedVal').textContent = '1x';
        if ($('hackZoom')) $('hackZoom').value = 1; $('hackZoomVal').textContent = '1x';
        if ($('hackAutoClick')) $('hackAutoClick').checked = false;
        if ($('hackMute')) $('hackMute').checked = false;
        $('hackPauseBtn').textContent = '⏸ Freeze';
        sendHack({ speed: 1, zoom: 1, autoclick: { on: false }, mute: false });
      };
      // reset all global hacks to defaults (without touching the current game) — used when opening a new game
      function resetHacksSilently() {
        hackSpeed = 1; hackPaused = false; hackZoom = 1; hackAutoClick = false; hackMute = false;
        setBoth('hackSpeed', 'cgSpeed', 'value', 1); setBoth('hackSpeedVal', 'cgSpeedVal', 'textContent', '1x');
        setBoth('hackZoom', 'cgZoom', 'value', 1); setBoth('hackZoomVal', 'cgZoomVal', 'textContent', '1x');
        setBoth('hackAutoClick', 'cgAuto', 'checked', false); setBoth('hackMute', 'cgMute', 'checked', false);
        setBoth('hackPauseBtn', 'cgPauseBtn', 'textContent', '⏸ Freeze');
      }

      window.submitBypassCode = async function() {
        const input = $('shutdownCodeInput'), msg = $('shutdownCodeMsg');
        const code = input.value.trim();
        if (!code) return;
        msg.textContent = 'Checking...';
        try {
          const res = await fetch('https://freeeducation2026.buffoloremote.workers.dev/api/verify-code', {
            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, cache: 'no-store',
            body: JSON.stringify({ code: code }),
          });
          const d = await res.json();
          if (d && d.ok) {
            lsSet('shutdownBypassCode', code);
            input.value = '';
            msg.textContent = '';
            pollNow();
          } else msg.textContent = "That code isn't right.";
        } catch (e) { msg.textContent = 'Could not check the code.'; }
      };
      $('shutdownCodeInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') submitBypassCode(); });

      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() { updateMonitoring(); if (!document.hidden) pollNow(); });
      window.addEventListener('focus', function() { pollNow(); });
      window.addEventListener('blur', function() { pollNow(); });

      // ---------- auto-show admin on refresh (toggle, default on) ----------
      function autoOpenOn() { return lsGet('adminAutoOpen') !== '0'; }
      window.setAutoOpen = function(on) { lsSet('adminAutoOpen', on ? '1' : '0'); };
      // keep the settings checkbox in sync whenever the main view shows
      (function () {
        const cb = $('autoOpenCheck'); if (cb) cb.checked = autoOpenOn();
      })();

      // ---------- start ----------
      renderPanel();
      syncCheatsUI();
      applyNoticePos();
      scheduleReminder(8 * 60000); // first tip ~8 min after the page opens

      // If you're already logged in (remembered) and haven't turned this off,
      // pop the admin up in the bottom-right so you don't have to type "admin" again.
      if (isLoggedIn() && autoOpenOn()) {
        const cb = $('autoOpenCheck'); if (cb) cb.checked = true;
        // get the logged-in view ready so one click on the gear shows it
        $('adminLoginView').style.display = 'none';
        $('adminMainView').style.display = 'block';
        showAdminTab(lsGet('adminLastTab') || 'overview');
        if (getPanelMode() === 'tab') {
          renderPanel(); // the Admin nav tab shows itself when logged in
        } else {
          panelState = 'minimized'; // shows the gear button in the bottom-right
          renderPanel();
        }
        loadAnalytics();
      }

      pollNow();
    })();
  </script>
  <!-- ============ END ADMIN PANEL ============ -->

</body>
</html>
